definition:
Commonly a ring engraved with some device (Gen. 38:18, 25). Jezebel 'wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with his seal'(1 Kings 21:8). Seals are frequently mentioned in Jewish history (Deut. 32:34; Neh. 9:38; 10:1; Esther 3:12; Cant. 8:6; Isa. 8:16; Jer. 22:24; 32:44, etc.). Sealing a document was equivalent to the signature of the owner of the seal. 'The use of a signet-ring by the monarch has recently received a remarkable illustration by the discovery of an impression of such a signet on fine clay at Koyunjik, the site of the ancient Nineveh. This seal appears to have been impressed from the bezel of a metallic finger-ring. It is an oval, 2 inches in length by 1 inch wide, and bears the image, name, and titles of the Egyptian king Sabaco' (Rawlinson's Hist. Illus. of the O.T., p. 46). The actual signet-rings of two Egyptian kings (Cheops and Horus) have been discovered. (See [559]SIGNET.)

The use of seals is mentioned in the New Testament only in connection with the record of our Lord's burial (Matt. 27:66). The tomb was sealed by the Pharisees and chief priests for the purpose of making sure that the disciples would not come and steal the body away (ver. 63, 64). The mode of doing this was probably by stretching a cord across the stone and sealing it at both ends with sealing-clay. When God is said to have sealed the Redeemer, the meaning is, that he has attested his divine mission (John 6:27). Circumcision is a seal, an attestation of the covenant (Rom. 4:11). Believers are sealed with the Spirit, as God's mark put upon them (Eph. 1:13; 4:30). Converts are by Paul styled the seal of his apostleship, i.e., they are its attestation (1 Cor. 9:2). Seals and sealing are frequently mentioned in the book of Revelation (5:1; 6:1; 7:3; 10:4; 22:10).
definitionAm:
በተለምዶ አንዳንድ ምልክቶች የተቀረጹበት ቀለበት (ዘፍ. 38፡18፣ 25)። ኤልዛቤል 'በአክዓብ ስም ደብዳቤዎችን ጻፈች፣ በገዛ ማኅተሙም አተመችባቸው' (1 ነገሥት 21፡8)። ማኅተሞች በአይሁድ ታሪክ ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ ተጠቅሰዋል (ዘዳ. 32፡34፤ ነህምያ 9፡38፤ አስቴር 3፡12፤ ኢሳ. 8፡16፤ ኤር. 22፡24፤ 32፡44)። ሰነድን ማኅተም ማድረግ ከባለቤቱ ፊርማ ጋር እኩል ነበር። 'ንጉሠ ነገሥቱ የጣት ቀለበት ማኅተም መጠቀሙ በቅርቡ በጥንቷ ነነዌ ቦታ በኮዩንጂክ በደቃቅ ሸክላ ላይ በተገኘው ማኅተም አስገራሚ ማሳያ ሆኗል። ይህ ማኅተም ከብረት የጣት ቀለበት የታተመ ይመስላል። 2 ኢንች ርዝመትና 1 ኢንች ስፋት ያለው ሞላላ ቅርጽ ሲሆን የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሳባኮ ምስል፣ ስም እና ማዕረግ ይዟል።' የሁለት የግብፅ ነገሥታት (ቼፕስ እና ሆረስ) ትክክለኛ የጣት ቀለበት ማኅተሞች ተገኝተዋል። ([559]ሲግኔትን ይመልከቱ።)

የማኅተሞች አጠቃቀም በአዲስ ኪዳን የተጠቀሰው ከጌታችን ቀብር ጋር በተያያዘ ብቻ ነው (ማቴ. 27፡66)። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥተው አካሉን እንዳይሰርቁ ለማድረግ መቃብሩ በፈሪሳውያንና በካህናት አለቆች ታትሞ ነበር (ቁጥር 63፣ 64)። ይህን የማድረጊያ ዘዴው ምናልባት በድንጋዩ ላይ ገመድ በመዘርጋት እና በሁለቱም ጫፎች በማኅተም ጭቃ በማተም ሳይሆን አይቀርም። እግዚአብሔር አዳኙን አትሞታል ሲባል፣ ትርጉሙ መለኮታዊ ተልእኮውን አረጋግጧል ማለት ነው (ዮሐንስ 6፡27)። ግዝረት የማኅተም፣ የቃል ኪዳኑ ማረጋገጫ ነው (ሮሜ 4፡11)። አማኞች በእግዚአብሔር ምልክት በመንፈስ የታተሙ ናቸው (ኤፌሶን 1፡13፤ 4፡30)። አማኞች በጳውሎስ የሐዋርያነቱ ማኅተም ተብለዋል፣ ማለትም የእርሱ ማረጋገጫዎች ናቸው (1 ቆሮ. 9፡2)። ማኅተሞችና ማተም በራእይ መጽሐፍ ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ ተጠቅሰዋል (5፡1፤ 6፡1፤ 7፡3፤ 10፡4፤ 22፡10)።

definition: A figurative expression used in Rev. 4:6 and 15:2. According to the interpretation of some, 'this calm, glass-like sea, which is never in storm, but only interfused with flame, represents the counsels of God, those purposes of righteousness and love which are often fathomless but never obscure, always the same, though sometimes glowing with holy anger.' (Comp. Ps. 36:6; 77:19; Rom. 11:33-36.)
definitionAm: በራእይ 4፡6 እና 15፡2 ላይ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለ ምሳሌያዊ አነጋገር። እንደ አንዳንዶች ትርጓሜ ከሆነ፣ 'ይህ ጸጥ ያለ፣ መስታወት የመሰለ ባሕር፣ በጭራሽ ማዕበል የሌለበት፣ ነገር ግን በእሳት የተደባለቀ፣ የእግዚአብሔርን ምክር፣ እነዚያን ብዙ ጊዜ ጥልቀታቸው የማይታወቅ ነገር ግን ግልጽ ያልሆኑ፣ ሁል ጊዜ ተመሳሳይ የሆኑ፣ ምንም እንኳን አንዳንዴ በቅዱስ ቁጣ የሚነድዱ የጽድቅ እና የፍቅር ዓላማዎችን ያሳያል።' (ከመዝ. 36፡6፤ 77፡19፤ ሮሜ 11፡33-36 ጋር ይነጻጸር።)

definition: (Jer. 48:32), a lake, now represented by some ponds in the high valley in which the Ammonite city of Jazer lies, the ruins of which are called Sar.
definitionAm: (ኤር. 48፡32)፣ በአሁኑ ጊዜ የአሞናውያን ከተማ ኢያዜር በምትገኝበት ከፍታ ባለው ሸለቆ ውስጥ በሚገኙ አንዳንድ ኩሬዎች የሚወከል ሐይቅ ነው፣ ፍርስራሹም ሳር ይባላል።

definition: (Gen. 8:22). See [560]AGRICULTURE; [561]MONTH.
definitionAm: (ዘፍ. 8:22)። [560]ግብርናን፤ [561]ወርን ይመልከቱ።

definition: (Heb. yam), signifies (1) 'the gathering together of the waters,' the ocean (Gen. 1:10); (2) a river, as the Nile (Isa. 19:5), the Euphrates (Isa. 21:1; Jer. 51:36); (3) the Red Sea (Ex. 14:16, 27; 15:4, etc.); (4) the Mediterranean (Ex. 23:31; Num. 34:6, 7; Josh. 15:47; Ps. 80:11, etc.); (5) the 'sea of Galilee,' an inland fresh-water lake, and (6) the Dead Sea or 'salt sea' (Gen. 14:3; Num. 34:3, 12, etc.). The word 'sea' is used symbolically in Isa. 60:5, where it probably means the nations around the Mediterranean. In Dan. 7:3, Rev. 13:1 it may mean the tumultuous changes among the nations of the earth.
definitionAm: (ዕብ. ያም)፣ የሚከተሉትን ያመለክታል፡ (1) 'የውኃ መከማቻ'፣ ውቅያኖስ (ዘፍ. 1፡10)፤ (2) ወንዝ፣ እንደ አባይ (ኢሳ. 19፡5)፣ ኤፍራጥስ (ኢሳ. 21፡1፤ ኤር. 51፡36)፤ (3) ቀይ ባሕር (ዘፀ. 14፡16፣ 27፤ 15፡4)፤ (4) ሜዲትራኒያን (ዘፀ. 23፡31፤ ዘኁ. 34፡6፣ 7፤ ኢያሱ 15፡47፤ መዝ. 80፡11)፤ (5) 'የገሊላ ባሕር'፣ የንጹህ ውኃ ሐይቅ፣ እና (6) የሙት ባሕር ወይም 'የጨው ባሕር' (ዘፍ. 14፡3፤ ዘኁ. 34፡3፣ 12)። 'ባሕር' የሚለው ቃል በኢሳ. 60፡5 ላይ በምሳሌነት ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል፣ ይህም ምናልባት በሜዲትራኒያን ዙሪያ ያሉትን ብሔራት ሊያመለክት ይችላል። በዳን. 7፡3 እና በራእይ 13፡1 ላይ በምድር አሕዛብ መካከል ያለውን ሁከት የተሞላበት ለውጥ ሊያመለክት ይችላል።

definition: The great laver made by Solomon for the use of the priests in the temple, described in 1 Kings 7:23-26; 2 Chr. 4:2-5. It stood in the south-eastern corner of the inner court. It was 5 cubits high, 10 in diameter from brim to brim, and 30 in circumference. It was placed on the backs of twelve oxen, standing with their faces outward. It was capable of containing two or three thousand baths of water (comp. 2 Chr. 4:5), which was originally supplied by the Gibeonites, but was afterwards brought by a conduit from the pools of Bethlehem. It was made of 'brass' (copper), which Solomon had taken from the captured cities of Hadarezer, the king of Zobah (1 Chr. 18:8). Ahaz afterwards removed this laver from the oxen, and placed it on a stone pavement (2 Kings 16:17). It was destroyed by the Chaldeans (25:13).
definitionAm: ሰለሞን በቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ ለካህናቱ አገልግሎት እንዲውል የሠራው ታላቅ የውኃ ገንዳ ሲሆን በ1 ነገሥት 7፡23-26 እና በ2 ዜና 4፡2-5 ተገልጿል። በውስጠኛው አደባባይ በደቡብ ምስራቅ ጥግ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር። ቁመቱ 5 ክንድ፣ ከአንድ ዳር እስከ ሌላው ዳር ያለው ዲያሜትር 10 ክንድ፣ ዙሪያውም 30 ክንድ ነበረ። ፊታቸው ወደ ውጭ በዞረ በአሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ጀርባ ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር። ከሁለት እስከ ሦስት ሺህ ባት ውኃ የመያዝ አቅም ነበረው (2 ዜና 4፡5)፤ ይህም መጀመሪያ በገባኦናውያን ይቀርብ ነበር፣ በኋላ ግን ከቤተልሔም ኩሬዎች በቧንቧ ይመጣ ነበር። ሰለሞን የጾባ ንጉሥ ከሆነው ከሐዳሬዘር ከተሞች ከማረከው 'ናስ' (መዳብ) የተሠራ ነበር (1 ዜና 18፡8)። አካዝ በኋላ ይህንን የውኃ ገንዳ ከበሬዎቹ ላይ አንስቶ በድንጋይ ንጣፍ ላይ አኖረው (2 ነገሥት 16፡17)። በከለዳውያንም ጠፋ (25፡13)።

definition: (1.) One of the sons of Cush (Gen. 10:7). (2.) The name of a country and nation (Isa. 43:3; 45:14) mentioned along with Egypt and Ethiopia, and therefore probably in north-eastern Africa. The ancient name of Meroe. The kings of Sheba and Seba are mentioned together in Ps. 72:10.
definitionAm: (1.) ከኩሽ ልጆች አንዱ (ዘፍ. 10፡7)። (2.) ከግብፅና ከኢትዮጵያ ጋር ተጠቃሽ የሆነ የአገርና የሕዝብ ስም (ኢሳ. 43፡3፤ 45፡14)፣ ስለዚህም ሳይሆን አይቀርም በሰሜን ምስራቅ አፍሪካ የሚገኝ ነው። የጥንቷ መሮዌ ስም ነው። የሳባ እና የሴባ ነገሥታት በመዝሙር 72፡10 ላይ አንድ ላይ ተጠቅሰዋል።

definition: The eleventh month of the Hebrew year, extending from the new moon of February to that of March (Zech. 1:7). Assyrian sabatu, 'storm.' (See [562]MONTH.)
definitionAm: ከየካቲት አዲስ ጨረቃ እስከ መጋቢት ድረስ የሚዘልቅ የዕብራውያን ዓመት አሥራ አንደኛው ወር (ዘካ. 1፡7)። በአሦራውያን 'ሳባቱ' ሲሆን ትርጉሙም 'ማዕበል' ማለት ነው።

definition: Enclosure, one of the six cities in the wilderness of Judah, noted for its 'great cistern' (Josh. 15:61). It has been identified with the ruin Sikkeh, east of Bethany.
definitionAm: አጥር፤ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ ካሉት ስድስት ከተሞች አንዷ ስትሆን በ'ታላቅ ጉድጓድ' ትታወቃለች (ኢያሱ 15፡61)። ከቢታንያ በስተምስራቅ ካለው ከሲኬ ፍርስራሽ ጋር ትታወቃለች።

definition: A hill or watch-tower, a place between Gibeah and Ramah noted for its 'great well' (1 Sam. 19:22); probably the modern Suweikeh, south of Beeroth.
definitionAm: ኮረብታ ወይም የመጠበቂያ ግንብ፤ በጊብዓ እና በራማ መካከል ያለ በ'ታላቅ ጉድጓድ' የሚታወቅ ቦታ (1 ሳሙ. 19፡22)፤ ምናልባትም ከቤሮት በስተደቡብ የሚገኘው ዘመናዊው ሱወይካ ሳይሆን አይቀርም።

definition: (Gr. hairesis, usually rendered 'heresy', Acts 24:14; 1 Chr. 11:19; Gal. 5:20, etc.), meaning properly 'a choice,' then 'a chosen manner of life,' and then 'a religious party,' as the 'sect' of the Sadducees (Acts 5:17), of the Pharisees (15:5), the Nazarenes, i.e., Christians (24:5). It afterwards came to be used in a bad sense, of those holding pernicious error, divergent forms of belief (2 Pet. 2:1; Gal. 5:20).
definitionAm: (ከግሪኩ 'ሃይሬሲስ'፤ ብዙውን ጊዜ 'መናፍቅነት' ተብሎ ይተረጎማል፣ ሐዋ. 24፡14፤ 1 ዜና 11፡19፤ ገላ. 5፡20፣ ወዘተ) ትርጉሙም በትክክል 'ምርጫ'፣ ከዚያም 'የተመረጠ የሕይወት መንገድ'፣ እና ከዚያም 'ሃይማኖታዊ ወገን' ማለት ነው፣ ለምሳሌ እንደ ሰዱቃውያን 'ክፍል' (ሐዋ. 5፡17)፣ የፈሪሳውያን (15፡5)፣ የናዝሬታውያን ማለትም ክርስቲያኖች (24፡5)። በኋላም ጎጂ ስህተትን ለሚከተሉ፣ የተለየ የእምነት ዓይነቶች ላላቸው በመጥፎ ትርጉም ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል (2 ጴጥ. 2፡1፤ ገላ. 5፡20)።

definition: Second, a Christian of Thessalonica who accompanied Paul into Asia (Acts 20:4).
definitionAm: ሁለተኛ፤ ጳውሎስን ወደ እስያ አብሮት የሄደ የተሰሎንቄ ክርስቲያን (ሐዋ. 20፡4)።

definition: A name sometimes applied to the prophets because of the visions granted to them. It is first found in 1 Sam. 9:9. It is afterwards applied to Zadok, Gad, etc. (2 Sam. 15:27; 24:11; 1 Chr. 9:22; 25:5; 2 Chr. 9:29; Amos 7:12; Micah 3:7). The 'sayings of the seers' (2 Chr. 33:18, 19) is rendered in the Revised Version 'the history of Hozai' (marg., the seers; so the LXX.), of whom, however, nothing is known. (See [563]PROPHET.)
definitionAm: ለነቢያት ለሚሰጣቸው ራእይ ምክንያት አንዳንድ ጊዜ የሚሰጥ ስም። በመጀመሪያ በ1 ሳሙ. 9፡9 ላይ ተገኝቷል። በኋላም ለሳዶቅ፣ ለጋድ ወዘተ ተሰጥቷል (2 ሳሙ. 15፡27፤ 24፡11፤ 1 ዜና 9፡22፤ 25፡5፤ 2 ዜና 9፡29፤ አሞጽ 7፡12፤ ሚክያስ 3፡7)። 'የባለ ራእዮች ቃል' (2 ዜና 33፡18፣ 19) በተሻሻለው እትም 'የሆዛይ ታሪክ' ተብሎ ተተርጉሟል፣ ሆኖም ስለ እርሱ ምንም የሚታወቅ ነገር የለም።

definition: To boil (Ex. 16:23).
definitionAm: መቀቀል ወይም ማፍላት (ዘጸ. 16፡23)።

definition: A vessel for boiling provisions in (Job 41:20; Jer. 1:13).
definitionAm: ምግብ የሚበስልበት ዕቃ (ኢዮብ 41፡20፤ ኤር. 1፡13)።

definition: Elevated. (1.) The youngest son of Hiel the Bethelite. His death is recorded in 1 Kings 16:34 (comp. Josh. 6:26). (2.) A descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 2:21, 22).
definitionAm: ከፍ ያለ። (1.) የቤቴላዊው የሒኤል ታናሽ ልጅ። ሞቱ በ1 ነገሥት 16፡34 ተመዝግቧል (ኢያሱ 6፡26)። (2.) የይሁዳ ዘር (1 ዜና 2፡21፣ 22)።

definition: Rough; hairy. (1.) A Horite; one of the 'dukes' of Edom (Gen. 36:20-30). (2.) The name of a mountainous region occupied by the Edomites, extending along the eastern side of the Arabah from the south-eastern extremity of the Dead Sea to near the Akabah, or the eastern branch of the Red Sea. It was originally occupied by the Horites (Gen. 14:6), who were afterwards driven out by the Edomites (Gen. 32:3; 33:14, 16). It was allotted to the descendants of Esau (Deut. 2:4, 22; Josh. 24:4; 2 Chr. 20:10; Isa. 21:11; Exek. 25:8). (3.) A mountain range (not the Edomite range, Gen. 32:3) lying between the Wady Aly and the Wady Ghurab (Josh. 15:10).
definitionAm: ሻካራ፤ ጸጉራም። (1.) ሖራዊ፤ ከኤዶም መኳንንት አንዱ (ዘፍ. 36፡20-30)። (2.) በኤዶማውያን የተያዘ ተራራማ ክልል ስም፣ ከሙት ባሕር ደቡብ ምስራቅ ጫፍ ጀምሮ በአረባ ምስራቃዊ በኩል እስከ አቃባ ወይም እስከ ቀይ ባሕር ምስራቃዊ ቅርንጫፍ ድረስ ይዘልቃል። በመጀመሪያ በሖራውያን የተያዘ ነበር (ዘፍ. 14፡6)፣ እነርሱም በኋላ በኤዶማውያን ተባረሩ (ዘፍ. 32፡3፤ 33፡14፣ 16)። ለዔሳው ዘሮች ተሰጥቷል (ዘዳ. 2፡4፣ 22፤ ኢያሱ 24፡4፤ 2 ዜና 20፡10፤ ኢሳ. 21፡11፤ ሕዝ. 25፡8)። (3.) በዋዲ አሊ እና በዋዲ ጉራብ መካከል የሚገኝ የተራራ ሰንሰለት (የኤዶማውያን ሰንሰለት አይደለም፣ ዘፍ. 32፡3) (ኢያሱ 15፡10)።

definition: Woody district; shaggy, a place among the mountains of Ephraim, bordering on Benjamin, to which Ehud fled after he had assassinated Eglon at Jericho (Judg. 3:26, 27).
definitionAm: ደን ያለበት አካባቢ፤ በኤፍሬም ተራሮች መካከል ከብንያም ጋር በሚዋሰነው አካባቢ የሚገኝ ቦታ ሲሆን ናዖድ ኤግሎንን በኢያሪኮ ከገደለው በኋላ ወደዚያ ሸሸ (መሳ. 3፡26፣ 27)።

definition: =Se'lah, rock, the capital of Edom, situated in the great valley extending from the Dead Sea to the Red Sea (2 Kings 14:7). It was near Mount Hor, close by the desert of Zin. It is called 'the rock' (Judg. 1:36). When Amaziah took it he called it Joktheel (q.v.) It is mentioned by the prophets (Isa. 16:1; Obad. 1:3) as doomed to destruction. It appears in later history and in the Vulgate Version under the name of Petra. 'The caravans from all ages, from the interior of Arabia and from the Gulf of Persia, from Hadramaut on the ocean, and even from Sabea or Yemen, appear to have pointed to Petra as a common centre; and from Petra the tide seems again to have branched out in every direction, to Egypt, Palestine, and Syria, through Arsinoe, Gaza, Tyre, Jerusalem, and Damascus, and by other routes, terminating at the Mediterranean.'
definitionAm: አለት፤ ከሙት ባሕር እስከ ቀይ ባሕር በሚዘልቀው ታላቅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ የምትገኝ የኤዶም ዋና ከተማ (2 ነገሥት 14፡7)። በሖር ተራራ አቅራቢያ፣ በጺን ምድረ በዳ አጠገብ ነበረች። 'አለቱ' ተብላ ትጠራለች (መሳ. 1፡36)። አሜስያስ በያዛት ጊዜ ዮቅትኤል ብሎ ጠራት። በነቢያት ዘንድ ለጥፋት የተወሰነች ተብላ ተጠቅሳለች (ኢሳ. 16፡1፤ አብድዩ 1፡3)። በኋለኛው ታሪክ እና በቩልጌት ትርጉም በፔትራ ስም ትታወቃለች። ከሁሉም ዘመናት የመጡ ተሳፋሪዎች፣ ከአረቢያ ውስጠኛ ክፍል እና ከፋርስ ባሕረ ሰላጤ፣ በውቅያኖስ ላይ ካለው ከሐድራማውት፣ አልፎ ተርፎም ከሳባ ወይም ከየመን፣ ፔትራን እንደ የጋራ ማእከል አድርገው ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ ከፔትራም ማዕበሉ በየአቅጣጫው ወደ ግብፅ፣ ፍልስጤም እና ሶሪያ፣ በአርሲኖ፣ በጋዛ፣ በጢሮስ፣ በኢየሩሳሌም እና በደማስቆ እንዲሁም በሌሎች መንገዶች ተዘርግቶ በሜዲትራኒያን ባሕር ይጠናቀቃል።

definition: A word frequently found in the Book of Psalms, and also in Hab. 3:9, 13, about seventy-four times in all in Scripture. Its meaning is doubtful. Some interpret it as meaning 'silence' or 'pause;' others, 'end,' 'a louder strain,' 'piano,' etc. The LXX. render the word by daplasma i.e., 'a division.'
definitionAm: በመዝሙረ ዳዊት እና በዕንባቆም 3፡9፣ 13 ላይ በተደጋጋሚ የሚገኝ ቃል ሲሆን በጠቅላላው በመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ውስጥ 74 ጊዜ ያህል ይገኛል። ትርጉሙ አጠራጣሪ ነው። አንዳንዶች 'ዝምታ' ወይም 'ዕረፍት' እንደሆነ ይተረጉሙታል፤ ሌሎች ደግሞ 'መጨረሻ'፣ 'ከፍ ያለ ዜማ' ወዘተ ይሉታል። የሰባ ሊቃናት ትርጉም ቃሉን 'ዳፕላስማ' ማለትም 'ክፍል' በማለት ይተረጉመዋል።

definition: Cliff of divisions the name of the great gorge which lies between Hachilah and Maon, south-east of Hebron. This gorge is now called the Wady Malaky. This was the scene of the interview between David and Saul mentioned in 1 Sam. 26:13. Each stood on an opposing cliff, with this deep chasm between.
definitionAm: የመለያየት ድንጋይ፤ ከኬብሮን በስተደቡብ ምስራቅ በሐኪላ እና በመዓዎን መካከል የሚገኘው የታላቁ ገደል ስም ነው። ይህ ገደል አሁን ዋዲ ማላኪ ይባላል። በ1 ሳሙ. 26፡13 ላይ የተጠቀሰው በዳዊትና በሳኦል መካከል የተደረገው ቃለ ምልልስ የተካሄደበት ቦታ ነበር። እያንዳንዳቸው በተቃራኒ ገደል ላይ ቆመው ነበር፣ በመካከላቸውም ይህ ጥልቅ ገደል ነበረ።

definition: The sea-port of Antioch, near the mouth of the Orontes. Paul and his companions sailed from this port on their first missionary journey (Acts 13:4). This city was built by Seleucus Nicator, the 'king of Syria.' It is said of him that 'few princes have ever lived with so great a passion for the building of cities. He is reputed to have built in all nine Seleucias, sixteen Antiochs, and six Laodiceas.' Seleucia became a city of great importance, and was made a 'free city' by Pompey. It is now a small village, called el-Kalusi.
definitionAm: በኦሮንቴስ አፍ አቅራቢያ የሚገኘው የአንጾኪያ የባሕር ወደብ። ጳውሎስና ባልንጀሮቹ በመጀመሪያው ሚስዮናዊ ጉዟቸው ከዚህ ወደብ ተነስተው በመርከብ ሄዱ (ሐዋ. 13፡4)። ይህች ከተማ በሶርያ ንጉሥ በሰሌውቆስ ኒካጦር የተገነባች ናት። ስለ እርሱ 'እንደ እርሱ ከተማዎችን የመገንባት ፍላጎት የነበረው ልዑል ጥቂት ነው' ይባላል። በጠቅላላው ዘጠኝ ሰሌውቅያዎችን፣ አሥራ ስድስት አንጾኪያዎችን እና ስድስት ሎዶቅያዎችን እንደገነባ ይነገራል። ሰሌውቅያ ትልቅ ጠቀሜታ ያላት ከተማ ሆነች፣ በፖምፔም 'ነጻ ከተማ' ተባለች። አሁን ኤል-ካሉሲ የምትባል ትንሽ መንደር ናት።

definition: Mentioned in the genealogy of our Lord (Luke 3:26).
definitionAm: በጌታችን የትውልድ ሐረግ ውስጥ ተጠቅሷል (ሉቃስ 3፡26)።

definition: Thorny, a place many of the inhabitants of which returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:35; Neh. 7:38).
definitionAm: እሾሃማ፤ ብዙ ነዋሪዎቿ ከዘሩባቤል ጋር ከባቢሎን የተመለሱባት ቦታ (ዕዝራ 2፡35፤ ነህ. 7፡38)።

definition: (Acts 5:21), the 'elders of Israel' who formed a component part of the Sanhedrin.

definition: The acacia; rock-thorn, the southern cliff in the Wady es-Suweinit, a valley south of Michmash, which Jonathan climbed with his armour-bearer (1 Sam. 14:4, 5). The rock opposite, on the other side of the wady, was called Bozez.
definitionAm: ግራር፤ የድንጋይ እሾህ፤ ከሚክማስ በስተደቡብ በሚገኘው በዋዲ ኤስ-ሱወይኒት ውስጥ የሚገኝ ደቡባዊ ገደል ሲሆን ዮናታን ከጋሻ ጃግሬው ጋር የወጣው ነው (1 ሳሙ. 14፡4፣ 5)። ማዶ ያለው ገደል በሌላኛው በኩል ቦጼጽ ይባል ነበር።

definition: =Shenir, the name given to Hermon by the Amorites (Deut. 3:9). It means 'coat of mail' or 'breastplate,' and is equivalent to 'Sirion.' Some interpret the word as meaning 'the prominent' or 'the snowy mountain'. It is properly the name of the central of the three summits of Hermon (q.v.).
definitionAm: አሞራውያን ለሕርሞን የሰጡት ስም (ዘዳ. 3፡9)። ትርጉሙ 'የጥሩር ጃኬት' ወይም 'የደረት መከላከያ' ማለት ሲሆን ከ'ሲርዮን' ጋር እኩል ነው። አንዳንዶች ቃሉን 'ታዋቂው' ወይም 'በረዷማ ተራራ' ብለው ይተረጉሙታል። በትክክል ከሦስቱ የሕርሞን ጫፎች የመካከለኛው ስም ነው።

definition: Sin (the god) sends many brothers, son of Sargon, whom he succeeded on the throne of Assyria (B.C. 705), in the 23rd year of Hezekiah. 'Like the Persian Xerxes, he was weak and vainglorious, cowardly under reverse, and cruel and boastful in success.' He first set himself to break up the powerful combination of princes who were in league against him. Among these was Hezekiah, who had entered into an alliance with Egypt against Assyria. He accordingly led a very powerful army of at least 200,000 men into Judea, and devastated the land on every side, taking and destroying many cities (2 Kings 18:13-16; comp. Isa. 22, 24, 29, and 2 Chr. 32:1-8). His own account of this invasion, as given in the Assyrian annals, is in these words: 'Because Hezekiah, king of Judah, would not submit to my yoke, I came up against him, and by force of arms and by the might of my power I took forty-six of his strong fenced cities; and of the smaller towns which were scattered about, I took and plundered a countless number. From these places I took and carried off 200,156 persons, old and young, male and female, together with horses and mules, asses and camels, oxen and sheep, a countless multitude; and Hezekiah himself I shut up in Jerusalem, his capital city, like a bird in a cage, building towers round the city to hem him in, and raising banks of earth against the gates, so as to prevent escape...Then upon Hezekiah there fell the fear of the power of my arms, and he sent out to me the chiefs and the elders of Jerusalem with 30 talents of gold and 800 talents of silver, and divers treasures, a rich and immense booty...All these things were brought to me at Nineveh, the seat of my government.' (Comp. Isa. 22:1-13 for description of the feelings of the inhabitants of Jerusalem at such a crisis.) Hezekiah was not disposed to become an Assyrian feudatory. He accordingly at once sought help from Egypt (2 Kings 18:20-24). Sennacherib, hearing of this, marched a second time into Palestine (2 Kings 18:17, 37; 19; 2 Chr. 32:9-23; Isa. 36:2-22. Isa. 37:25 should be rendered 'dried up all the Nile-arms of Matsor,' i.e., of Egypt, so called from the 'Matsor' or great fortification across the isthmus of Suez, which protected it from invasions from the east). Sennacherib sent envoys to try to persuade Hezekiah to surrender, but in vain. (See [565]TIRHAKAH.) He next sent a threatening letter (2 Kings 19:10-14), which Hezekiah carried into the temple and spread before the Lord. Isaiah again brought an encouraging message to the pious king (2 Kings 19:20-34). 'In that night' the angel of the Lord went forth and smote the camp of the Assyrians. In the morning, 'behold, they were all dead corpses.' The Assyrian army was annihilated. This great disaster is not, as was to be expected, taken notice of in the Assyrian annals. Though Sennacherib survived this disaster some twenty years, he never again renewed his attempt against Jerusalem. He was murdered by two of his own sons (Adrammelech and Sharezer), and was succeeded by another son, Esarhaddon (B.C. 681), after a reign of twenty-four years.
definitionAm: ሲን (አምላኩ) ብዙ ወንድሞችን ይልካል፤ የሳርጎን ልጅ ሲሆን በሕዝቅያስ በ23ኛው ዓመት በአሦር ዙፋን ላይ ተተካ (705 ዓ.ዓ)። 'እንደ ፋርሱ ጠረክሲስ ደካማና ከንቱ፣ በሽንፈት ጊዜ ፈሪ፣ በስኬት ጊዜ ግን ጨካኝና ትምክህተኛ ነበር።' በመጀመሪያ በእርሱ ላይ የተሰለፉትን የነገሥታት ጥምረት ለመበተን ተነሳ። ከእነዚህም መካከል ከግብፅ ጋር በአሦር ላይ ጥምረት የፈጠረው ሕዝቅያስ ይገኝበታል። በዚህም መሠረት ቢያንስ 200,000 ሰዎች ያሉት እጅግ ኃይለኛ ሠራዊት ወደ ይሁዳ መርቶ በየአቅጣጫው ምድሪቱን አወደመ፣ ብዙ ከተሞችንም ያዘና አጠፋ (2 ነገሥት 18፡13-16፤ ኢሳ. 22፣ 24፣ 29፣ እና 2 ዜና 32፡1-8)። በአሦር ታሪክ ውስጥ እንደተገለጸው ስለዚሁ ወረራ የራሱ ዘገባ እንዲህ ይላል፦ 'የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ለቀንበሬ ስላልተገዛ፣ በእርሱ ላይ ወጣሁ፣ በጦር መሣሪያ ኃይልና በኃይሌም አርባ ስድስት ጠንካራ የታጠሩ ከተሞቹን ያዝኩ፤ ተበታትነው ከነበሩት ትናንሽ ከተሞችም ስፍር ቁጥር የሌላቸውን ያዝኩና ዘረፍኩ። ከነዚህ ቦታዎች 200,156 ሰዎችን፣ ሽማግሌና ወጣት፣ ወንድና ሴት፣ ከፈረሶችና ከበቅሎዎች፣ ከአህዮችና ከግመሎች፣ ከበሬዎችና ከበጎች ጋር ስፍር ቁጥር የሌለውን ሕዝብ ማርኬ ወሰድኩ፤ ሕዝቅያስንም በዋና ከተማው በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ወፍ በቤቱ ዘጋሁት፣ እንዳያመልጥም በከተማዋ ዙሪያ ግንቦችን ሠራሁ... ከዚያም በሕዝቅያስ ላይ የጦር መሣሪያዬን የመፍራት ኃይል ወደቀበት፣ እርሱም የኢየሩሳሌምን መኳንንትና ሽማግሌዎች 30 መክሊት ወርቅና 800 መክሊት ብር፣ እንዲሁም ልዩ ልዩ ሀብቶችን፣ የበለፀገና እጅግ ብዙ ምርኮ ላከልኝ... እነዚህ ሁሉ ነገሮች በመንግሥቴ መቀመጫ በነነዌ ቀረቡልኝ።' ሕዝቅያስ የአሦር ተገዢ ለመሆን አልፈለገም። በዚህም መሠረት ወዲያውኑ ከግብፅ እርዳታ ፈለገ (2 ነገሥት 18፡20-24)። ሰናክሬም ይህንን ሰምቶ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ወደ ፍልስጤም ዘመተ (2 ነገሥት 18፡17፣ 37፤ 19፤ 2 ዜና 32፡9-23፤ ኢሳ. 36፡2-22)። ሰናክሬም ሕዝቅያስ እጁን እንዲሰጥ ለማሳመን መልእክተኞችን ላከ፣ ግን አልተሳካለትም። ቀጥሎም የማስፈራሪያ ደብዳቤ ላከ (2 ነገሥት 19፡10-14)፣ ሕዝቅያስም ወደ ቤተ መቅደስ ወስዶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘረጋው። ኢሳይያስ እንደገና ለደጋጉ ንጉሥ የሚያበረታታ መልእክት አመጣ (2 ነገሥት 19፡20-34)። 'በዚያች ሌሊት' የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ወጥቶ የአሦራውያንን ሰፈር መታ። ጠዋትም 'እነሆ ሁሉም በድኖች ነበሩ'። የአሦር ሠራዊት ጠፋ። ይህ ታላቅ ጥፋት፣ እንደሚጠበቀው ሁሉ በአሦር ታሪክ ውስጥ አልተጠቀሰም። ምንም እንኳን ሰናክሬም ከዚህ ጥፋት በኋላ ሃያ ዓመታት ያህል ቢቆይም፣ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ዳግመኛ ሙከራ አላደረገም። በሁለት የገዛ ልጆቹ (አድራሜሌክና ሳራሳር) ተገደለ፣ በሌላው ልጁ በኤስራዶንም ተተካ (681 ዓ.ዓ)።

definition: (Obad. 1:20), some locality unknown. The modern Jews think that Spain is meant, and hence they designate the Spanish Jews 'Sephardim,' as they do the German Jews by the name 'Ashkenazim,' because the rabbis call Germany Ashkenaz. Others identify it with Sardis, the capital of Lydia. The Latin father Jerome regarded it as an Assyrian word, meaning 'boundary,'' and interpreted the sentence, 'which is in Sepharad,' by 'who are scattered abroad in all the boundaries and regions of the earth.' Perowne says: 'Whatever uncertainty attaches to the word Sepharad, the drift of the prophecy is clear, viz., that not only the exiles from Babylon, but Jewish captives from other and distant regions, shall be brought back to live prosperously within the enlarged borders of their own land.'
definitionAm: (አብድዩ 1:20)፤ ያልታወቀ ቦታ ነው። ዘመናዊ አይሁዶች ስፔን ማለቱ እንደሆነ ያስባሉ፣ ስለሆነም ስፔናውያን አይሁዶችን 'ሴፋርዲም' ብለው ይጠሯቸዋል፣ ጀርመናውያን አይሁዶችን ደግሞ 'አሽከናዚም' ይሏቸዋል (ረቢዎች ጀርመንን አሽከናዝ ብለው ስለሚጠሯት)። ሌሎች ደግሞ የልድያ ዋና ከተማ ከሆነችው ከሰርዴስ ጋር ያመሳስሏታል። የላቲኑ አባት ጄሮም 'ወሰን' የሚል ትርጉም ያለው የአሦር ቃል አድርጎ ይቆጥረው ነበር፣ 'በሴፋራድ ያለው' የሚለውንም ዓረፍተ ነገር 'በምድር ዳርቻዎችና ክልሎች ሁሉ የተበተኑ' ብሎ ተርጉሞታል። ፔሮን እንዲህ ይላል፦ 'በሴፋራድ ቃል ላይ ምንም ዓይነት እርግጠኛ አለመሆን ቢኖርም፣ የትንቢቱ ፍሰት ግልጽ ነው፣ ይኸውም ከባቢሎን የተማረኩት ብቻ ሳይሆኑ ከሌሎችና ከሩቅ አካባቢዎች የመጡ አይሁዳውያን ምርኮኞች ተመልሰው በገዛ ምድራቸው ሰፊ ድንበሮች ውስጥ በብልጽግና እንዲኖሩ ይደረጋል።'

definition: Taken by Sargon, king of Assyria (2 Kings 17:24; 18:34; 19:13; Isa. 37:13). It was a double city, and received the common name Sepharvaim, i.e., 'the two Sipparas,' or 'the two booktowns.' The Sippara on the east bank of the Euphrates is now called Abu-Habba; that on the other bank was Accad, the old capital of Sargon I., where he established a great library. (See SARGON.) The recent discovery of cuneiform inscriptions at Tel el-Amarna in Egypt, consisting of official despatches to Pharaoh Amenophis IV. and his predecessor from their agents in Palestine, proves that in the century before the Exodus an active literary intercourse was carried on between these nations, and that the medium of the correspondence was the Babylonian language and script. (See KIRJATH-SEPHER.)
definitionAm: በአሦር ንጉሥ በሳርጎን የተያዘች (2 ነገሥት 17:24፤ 18:34፤ 19:13፤ ኢሳ. 37:13)። ድርብ ከተማ ነበረች፣ ሴፈርዋይም የሚል የጋራ ስም ተሰጥቷታል፣ ትርጉሙም 'ሁለቱ ሲፓራዎች' ወይም 'ሁለቱ የመጽሐፍ ከተሞች' ማለት ነው። በኤፍራጥስ ምስራቃዊ ዳርቻ የሚገኘው ሲፓራ አሁን አቡ-ሀባ ይባላል፤ በሌላኛው ዳርቻ የሚገኘው ደግሞ አራድ ሲሆን የሳርጎን ቀዳማዊ የድሮ መዲና ነበረች፣ እዚያም ታላቅ ቤተ መጻሕፍት አቋቁሞ ነበር። (ሳርጎንን ይመልከቱ።) በግብፅ ቴል ኤል-አማርና በቅርቡ የተገኙት የኩኒፎርም ጽሑፎች፣ ለፈርዖን አሜኖፊስ አራተኛ እና ለቀድሞው መሪ በፍልስጤም ካሉ ወኪሎቻቸው የተላኩ ይፋዊ መልእክቶችን የያዙ ሲሆኑ፣ እስራኤላውያን ከግብፅ ከመውጣታቸው ከአንድ ክፍለ ዘመን በፊት በእነዚህ አገሮች መካከል ንቁ የሆነ የጽሑፍ ግንኙነት እንደነበርና የመልእክቶቹ መገናኛም የባቢሎን ቋንቋና ጽሕፈት እንደነበር ያረጋግጣሉ። (ቂርያት-ሴፍርን ይመልከቱ።)

definition: First mentioned as purchased by Abraham for Sarah from Ephron the Hittite (Gen. 23:20). This was the 'cave of the field of Machpelah,' where also Abraham and Rebekah and Jacob and Leah were burried (79:29-32). In Acts 7:16 it is said that Jacob was 'laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.' It has been proposed, as a mode of reconciling the apparent discrepancy between this verse and Gen. 23:20, to read Acts 7:16 thus: 'And they [i.e., our fathers] were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor [the son] of Sychem.' In this way the purchase made by Abraham is not to be confounded with the purchase made by Jacob subsequently in the same district. Of this purchase by Abraham there is no direct record in the Old Testament. (See TOMB.)
definitionAm: ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተጠቀሰው አብርሃም ለሳራ ከኬጢያዊው ኤፍሮን እንደገዛው ነው (ዘፍ. 23:20)። ይህም አብርሃም፣ ርብቃ፣ ያዕቆብና ልያ የተቀበሩበት የ'መክፈላ እርሻ ዋሻ' ነበር (79:29-32)። በሐዋርያት ሥራ 7:16 ላይ ያዕቆብ 'አብርሃም በብር ዋጋ ከሴኬም አባት ከኤሞር ልጆች በገዛው መቃብር ተቀበረ' ይላል። በዚህ ቁጥር እና በዘፍጥረት 23:20 መካከል ያለውን ግልጽ ልዩነት ለማስታረቅ፣ የሐዋርያት ሥራ 7:16ን እንዲህ ለማንበብ ሃሳብ ቀርቧል፦ 'እነርሱም [ማለትም አባቶቻችን] ወደ ሴኬም ተሻገሩ፣ አብርሃምም ከሴኬም [ልጅ] ከኤሞር ልጆች በብር ዋጋ በገዛው መቃብር ተቀበሩ።' በዚህ መንገድ አብርሃም የፈጸመው ግዢ በኋላ ያዕቆብ በዚያው አካባቢ ከፈጸመው ግዢ ጋር አይቀላቀልም። አብርሃም ስለፈጸመው ስለዚህ ግዢ በብሉይ ኪዳን ቀጥተኛ መዝገብ የለም። (መቃብርን (TOMB) ይመልከቱ።)

definition: Abundance; princess, the daughter of Asher and grand-daughter of Jacob (Gen. 46:17); called also Sarah (Num. 26:46; R.V., 'Serah').
definitionAm: ብዛት፤ ልዕልት፣ የአሴር ልጅ እና የያዕቆብ የልጅ ልጅ (ዘፍ. 46:17)፤ ሳራም ተብላ ተጠርታለች (ዘኍ. 26:46፤ በሪቫይዝድ ቨርሽን 'ሤራ')።

definition: Soldier of Jehovah. (1.) The father of Joab (1 Chr. 4:13, 14). (2.) The grandfather of Jehu (1 Chr. 4:35). (3.) One of David's scribes or secretaries (2 Sam. 8:17). (4.) A Netophathite (Jer. 40:8), a chief priest of the time of Zedekiah. He was carried captive by Nebuchadnezzar to Babylon, and there put to death (2 Kings 25:18, 23). (5.) Ezra 2:2. (6.) Father of Ezra the scribe (7:1). (7.) A ruler of the temple (Neh. 11:11). (8.) A priest of the days of Jehoiakim (Neh. 12:1, 12). (9.) The son of Neriah. When Zedekiah made a journey to Babylon to do homage to Nebuchadnezzar, Seraiah had charge of the royal gifts to be presented on that occasion. Jeremiah took advantage of the occasion, and sent with Seraiah a word of cheer to the exiles in Babylon, and an announcement of the doom in store for that guilty city. The roll containing this message (Jer. 50:1-8) Seraiah was to read to the exiles, and then, after fixing a stone to it, was to throw it into the Euphrates, uttering, as it sank, the prayer recorded in Jer. 51:59-64. Babylon was at this time in the height of its glory, the greatest and most powerful monarchy in the world. Scarcely seventy years elapsed when the words of the prophet were all fulfilled. Jer. 51:59 is rendered in the Revised Version, 'Now Seraiah was chief chamberlain,' instead of 'was a quiet prince,' as in the Authorized Version.
definitionAm: የይሖዋ ወታደር። (1.) የኢዮአብ አባት (1 ዜና 4:13, 14)። (2.) የኢዩ አያት (1 ዜና 4:35)። (3.) ከዳዊት ጸሐፊዎች ወይም ጸሐፊዎች አንዱ (2 ሳሙ. 8:17)። (4.) ኔጦፋዊ (ኤር. 40:8)፣ በሴዴቅያስ ዘመን የነበረ የካህናት አለቃ። በናቡከደነጾር ተማርኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ተወሰደ፣ በዚያም ተገደለ (2 ነገሥት 25:18, 23)። (5.) ዕዝራ 2:2። (6.) የጸሐፊው የዕዝራ አባት (7:1)። (7.) የቤተ መቅደስ አስተዳዳሪ (ነህ. 11:11)። (8.) በኢዮአቄም ዘመን የነበረ ካህን (ነህ. 12:1, 12)። (9.) የኔርያ ልጅ። ሴዴቅያስ ለናቡከደነጾር ክብር ለመስጠት ወደ ባቢሎን በተጓዘ ጊዜ፣ በዚያ ወቅት የሚቀርቡትን የንጉሣዊ ስጦታዎች ሰራያ በኃላፊነት ይዞ ነበር። ኤርምያስ አጋጣሚውን በመጠቀም በባቢሎን ላሉ ምርኮኞች የማበረታቻ ቃል እና ለዚያች በደለኛ ከተማ የተዘጋጀውን የጥፋት አዋጅ በሰራያ በኩል ላከ። ሰራያ ይህን መልእክት የያዘውን ጥቅል (ኤር. 50:1-8) ለምርኮኞቹ ካነበበ በኋላ፣ ድንጋይ አስሮበት ወደ ኤፍራጥስ ሊወረውረውና ጥቅሉ ሲሰምጥ በኤር. 51:59-64 ላይ የተመዘገበውን ጸሎት ሊናገር ነበር። ባቢሎን በዚህ ጊዜ በክብሯ ጫፍ ላይ የነበረች፣ በዓለም ላይ ታላቅና ኃያል መንግሥት ነበረች። የነቢዩ ቃላት ሁሉ ፍጻሜያቸውን እስኪያገኙ ሰባ ዓመት እንኳ አልሞላም። ኤር. 51:59 በሪቫይዝድ ቨርሽን 'ሰራያም የቤት አዛዥ ነበረ' ተብሎ ተተርጉሟል፣ በኦቶራይዝድ ቨርሽን ግን 'ሰላማዊ መስፍን ነበር' ይላል።

definition: Mentioned in Isa. 6:2, 3, 6, 7. This word means fiery ones, in allusion, as is supposed, to their burning love. They are represented as 'standing' above the King as he sat upon his throne, ready at once to minister unto him. Their form appears to have been human, with the addition of wings. (See ANGELS.) This word, in the original, is used elsewhere only of the 'fiery serpents' (Num. 21:6, 8; Deut. 8:15; comp. Isa. 14:29; 30:6) sent by God as his instruments to inflict on the people the righteous penalty of sin.
definitionAm: በኢሳ. 6:2፣ 3፣ 6፣ 7 ላይ ተጠቅሰዋል። ይህ ቃል የሚቃጠሉ ማለት ሲሆን፣ ለሚነድ ፍቅራቸው ማጣቀሻ እንደሆነ ይታሰባል። ንጉሡ በዙፋኑ ላይ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፣ ወዲያውኑ ሊያገለግሉት በላይ 'ቆመው' ተገልጸዋል። ቅርጻቸው ክንፍ ያለው የሰው መልክ ይመስላል። (መላእክትን ይመልከቱ።) ይህ ቃል በዋናው ቋንቋ፣ እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ላይ የኃጢአትን ቅጣት እንዲያደርሱ እንደ መሣሪያው የላካቸውን 'የሚቃጠሉ እባቦች' (ዘኍ. 21:6፣ 8፤ ዘዳ. 8:15፤ ከኢሳ. 14:29፤ 30:6 ጋር ያወዳድሩ) ለመግለጽ ብቻ በሌላ ቦታ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል።

definition: Fear, one of the sons of Zebulun (Gen. 46:14).
definitionAm: ፍርሃት፤ ከዛብሎን ልጆች አንዱ (ዘፍ. 46:14)።

definition: Acts 16:35, 38 (R.V., 'lictors'), officers who attended the magistrates and assisted them in the execution of justice.
definitionAm: የሐዋርያት ሥራ 16:35፣ 38 (በሪቫይዝድ ቨርሽን 'ሊክተሮች')፣ ዳኞችን የሚያጅቡና ፍትሕን በማስፈጸም ረገድ የሚረዱ መኮንኖች።

definition: A 'prudent man' (R.V., 'man of understanding'), the deputy (R.V., 'proconsul') of Cyprus (Acts 13:6-13). He became a convert to Christianity under Paul, who visited this island on his first mission to the heathen. A remarkable memorial of this proconsul was recently (1887) discovered at Rome. On a boundary stone of Claudius his name is found, among others, as having been appointed (A.D. 47) one of the curators of the banks and the channel of the river Tiber. After serving his three years as proconsul at Cyprus, he returned to Rome, where he held the office referred to. As he is not saluted in Paul's letter to the Romans, he probably died before it was written.
definitionAm: 'አስተዋይ ሰው' (በሪቫይዝድ ቨርሽን 'መረዳት ያለው ሰው')፣ የቆጵሮስ አገረ ገዥ (በሪቫይዝድ ቨርሽን 'ፕሮኮንሰል') (ሐዋ. 13:6-13)። ጳውሎስ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አሕዛብን ለማስተማር ወደዚህች ደሴት በሄደ ጊዜ በጳውሎስ በኩል ወደ ክርስትና ተለወጠ። የዚህ ፕሮኮንሰል አስደናቂ መታሰቢያ በቅርቡ (በ1887) ሮም ውስጥ ተገኝቷል። በቅላውዴዎስ የድንበር ድንጋይ ላይ፣ በ47 ዓ.ም. የጥብርያዶስ ወንዝ ዳርቻዎችና ቦዮች ጠባቂዎች አንዱ ሆኖ ተሹሞ ከነበሩት መካከል ስሙ ተገኝቷል። በቆጵሮስ ለሦስት ዓመታት በፕሮኮንሰልነት ካገለገለ በኋላ ወደ ሮም ተመልሶ የተጠቀሰውን ሹመት ይዞ ነበር። ጳውሎስ ለሮሜ ሰዎች በላከው ደብዳቤ ላይ ሰላምታ ስላልተላከለት፣ ደብዳቤው ከመጻፉ በፊት ሳይሞት አልቀረም።

definition: After spending a night in solemn meditation and prayer in the lonely mountain-range to the west of the Lake of Galilee (Luke 6:12), on the following morning our Lord called to him his disciples, and from among them chose twelve, who were to be henceforth trained to be his apostles (Mark 3:14, 15). After this solemn consecration of the twelve, he descended from the mountain-peak to a more level spot (Luke 6:17), and there he sat down and delivered the 'sermon on the mount' (Matt. 5-7; Luke 6:20-49) to the assembled multitude. The mountain here spoken of was probably that known by the name of the 'Horns of Hattin' (Kurun Hattin), a ridge running east and west, not far from Capernaum. It was afterwards called the 'Mount of Beatitudes.'
definitionAm: በገሊላ ባሕር በስተ ምዕራብ በሚገኝ ብቸኛ ተራራ ላይ ሌሊቱን በጸሎትና በሃሳብ ካሳለፉ በኋላ (ሉቃስ 6:12)፣ በማግስቱ ጠዋት ጌታችን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ፣ ከዚያም በኋላ ሐዋርያት እንዲሆኑ የሚሰለጥኑ አሥራ ሁለቱን መረጠ (ማርቆስ 3:14, 15)። የአሥራ ሁለቱን ምርጫ ካከናወነ በኋላ፣ ከተራራው ጫፍ ወደ ሜዳማ ቦታ ወረደ (ሉቃስ 6:17)፣ እዚያም ተቀምጦ ለተሰበሰበው ሕዝብ 'የተራራውን ስብከት' (ማቴ. 5-7፤ ሉቃስ 6:20-49) ሰጠ። እዚህ የተጠቀሰው ተራራ ሳይሆን አይቀርም ተብሎ የሚታሰበው ከቅፍርናሆም ብዙም ሳይርቅ ከምስራቅ ወደ ምዕራብ በሚዘልቀው 'የሐጢን ቀንዶች' (ኩሩን ሐጢን) ተብሎ በሚጠራው ተራራ ነው። በኋላም 'የብፅዕና ተራራ' ተብሎ ተጠርቷል።

definition: (Heb. nahash; Gr. ophis), frequently noticed in Scripture. More than forty species are found in Syria and Arabia. The poisonous character of the serpent is alluded to in Jacob's blessing on Dan (Gen. 49:17; see Prov. 30:18, 19; James 3:7; Jer. 8:17). (See ADDER.) This word is used symbolically of a deadly, subtle, malicious enemy (Luke 10:19). The serpent is first mentioned in connection with the history of the temptation and fall of our first parents (Gen. 3). It has been well remarked regarding this temptation: 'A real serpent was the agent of the temptation, as is plain from what is said of the natural characteristic of the serpent in the first verse of the chapter (3:1), and from the curse pronounced upon the animal itself. But that Satan was the actual tempter, and that he used the serpent merely as his instrument, is evident (1) from the nature of the transaction; for although the serpent may be the most subtle of all the beasts of the field, yet he has not the high intellectual faculties which the tempter here displayed. (2.) In the New Testament it is both directly asserted and in various forms assumed that Satan seduced our first parents into sin (John 8:44; Rom. 16:20; 2 Cor. 11:3, 14; Rev. 12:9; 20:2).' Hodge's System. Theol., ii. 127.
definitionAm: (ዕብ. ናሃሽ፤ ግሪክ ኦፊስ)፣ በመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ ተጠቅሷል። በሶርያና በአረብ አገሮች ከአርባ በላይ ዝርያዎች ይገኛሉ። የእባብ መርዛማ ባህሪ ያዕቆብ ለዳን በሰጠው በረከት ላይ ተጠቅሷል (ዘፍ. 49:17፤ ምሳሌ 30:18፣ 19፤ ያዕቆብ 3:7፤ ኤር. 8:17 ይመልከቱ)። (እፉኝትን (ADDER) ይመልከቱ።) ይህ ቃል ለገዳይ፣ ተንኮለኛና ክፉ ጠላት በምሳሌነት ያገለግላል (ሉቃስ 10:19)። እባብ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተጠቀሰው ከመጀመሪያዎቹ ወላጆቻችን ፈተናና ውድቀት ታሪክ ጋር በተያያዘ ነው (ዘፍ. 3)። ስለዚህ ፈተና እንዲህ ተብሎ ተገልጿል፦ 'በምዕራፉ የመጀመሪያ ቁጥር (3:1) ላይ ስለ እባብ ተፈጥሮአዊ ባህሪ ከተጠቀሰውና በራሱ በእንስሳው ላይ ከተነገረው እርግማን እንደሚታወቀው፣ እውነተኛ እባብ የፈተናው ወኪል ነበር። ነገር ግን ሰይጣን ትክክለኛው ፈታኝ እንደነበረና እባቡን እንደ መሣሪያ ብቻ እንደተጠቀመበት ግልጽ ነው፤ (1) ከድርጊቱ ባህሪ፤ ምክንያቱም እባብ ከምድር አራዊት ሁሉ ተንኮለኛ ቢሆንም፣ ፈታኙ እዚህ ላይ ያሳየውን ከፍተኛ የአእምሮ ችሎታ የለውም። (2) በሐዲስ ኪዳን ሰይጣን የመጀመሪያዎቹን ወላጆቻችንን ወደ ኃጢአት እንዳሳታቸው በቀጥታም ሆነ በተለያዩ መንገዶች ተገልጿል (ዮሐንስ 8:44፤ ሮሜ 16:20፤ 2 ቆሮ. 11:3, 14፤ ራእይ 12:9፤ 20:2)።'

definition: (LXX. 'deadly,' Vulg. 'burning'), Num. 21:6, probably the naja haje of Egypt; some swift-springing, deadly snake (Isa. 14:29). After setting out from their encampment at Ezion-gaber, the Israelites entered on a wide sandy desert, which stretches from the mountains of Edom as far as the Persian Gulf. While traversing this region, the people began to murmur and utter loud complaints against Moses. As a punishment, the Lord sent serpents among them, and much people of Israel died. Moses interceded on their behalf, and by divine direction he made a 'brazen serpent,' and raised it on a pole in the midst of the camp, and all the wounded Israelites who looked on it were at once healed. (Comp. John 3:14, 15.) (See ASP.) This 'brazen serpent' was preserved by the Israelites till the days of Hezekiah, when it was destroyed (2 Kings 18:4). (See BRASS.)
definitionAm: (ሰብዓ ሊቃናት 'ገዳይ'፣ ቫልጌት 'የሚቃጠል')፣ ዘኍ. 21:6፣ ምናልባት የግብፅ ናጃ ሐጄ (naja haje) ሳይሆን አይቀርም፤ አንዳንድ በፍጥነት የሚዘልሉ ገዳይ እባቦች (ኢሳ. 14:29)። ከዓጽዮን-ጋቤር ሰፈራቸው ተነስተው ሲወጡ፣ እስራኤላውያን ከኤዶም ተራሮች እስከ ፋርስ ባሕረ ሰላጤ በሚዘልቀው ሰፊ አሸዋማ በረሃ ውስጥ ገቡ። ይህን አካባቢ ሲያቋርጡ ሕዝቡ በሙሴ ላይ ማጉረምረም ጀመሩ። እንደ ቅጣትም እግዚአብሔር እባቦችን በመካከላቸው ሰደደ፣ ብዙ የእስራኤል ሕዝብም ሞቱ። ሙሴ ስለ እነርሱ ማለደ፣ በእግዚአብሔርም መመሪያ 'የናስ እባብ' ሠርቶ በሰፈሩ መካከል በዓላማ ላይ ሰቀለው፣ የቆሰሉት እስራኤላውያን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ሲመለከቱ ወዲያው ይድኑ ነበር። (ከዮሐንስ 3:14, 15 ጋር ያወዳድሩ)። (እፉኝትን (ASP) ይመልከቱ።) ይህ 'የናስ እባብ' እስከ ሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ድረስ በእስራኤላውያን ዘንድ ተጠብቆ ቆይቷል፣ በዚያን ጊዜም ጠፍቷል (2 ነገሥት 18:4)። (ናስን (BRASS) ይመልከቱ።)

definition: Branch, the father of Nahor (Gen. 11:20-23); called Saruch in Luke 3:35.
definitionAm: ቅርንጫፍ፤ የናኮር አባት (ዘፍ. 11:20-23)፤ በሉቃስ 3:35 ላይ ሳሮሕ ተብሎ ተጠርቷል።

definition: Occurs only in 2 Kings 4:43, Authorized Version (R.V., 'servant'). The Hebrew word there rendered 'servitor' is elsewhere rendered 'minister,' 'servant' (Ex. 24:13; 33:11). Probably Gehazi, the personal attendant on Elisha, is here meant.
definitionAm: በኦቶራይዝድ ቨርሽን በ2 ነገሥት 4:43 ላይ ብቻ ይገኛል (በሪቫይዝድ ቨርሽን 'አገልጋይ')። እዚያ 'አገልጋይ' ተብሎ የተተረጎመው የዕብራይስጥ ቃል በሌላ ቦታ 'አገልጋይ' ወይም 'ሎሌ' ተብሎ ተተርጉሟል (ዘጸ. 24:13፤ 33:11)። ምናልባት የኤልሳዕ የግል ረዳት የሆነው ግያዝ እዚህ ጋር የታሰበ ይመስላል።

definition: Appointed; a substitute, the third son of Adam and Eve (Gen. 4:25; 5:3). His mother gave him this name, 'for God,' said she, 'hath appointed me [i.e., compensated me with] another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.'
definitionAm: የተሾመ፤ ምትክ፣ የአዳምና የሔዋን ሦስተኛ ልጅ (ዘፍ. 4:25፤ 5:3)። እናቱ ይህን ስም የሰጠችው፦ 'ቃየን በገደለው በአቤል ፋንታ እግዚአብሔር ሌላ ዘር ተክቶልኛል [በምላሹ ሰጥቶኛል]' በማለት ነው።

definition: Hidden, one of the spies sent to search the Promised Land. He was of the tribe of Asher (Num. 13:13).
definitionAm: የተሰወረ፤ የተስፋይቱን ምድር እንዲሰልሉ ከተላኩት ሰላዮች አንዱ። እርሱ ከአሴር ነገድ ነበር (ዘኍ. 13:13)።

definition: This number occurs frequently in Scripture, and in such connections as lead to the supposition that it has some typical meaning. On the seventh day God rested, and hallowed it (Gen. 2:2, 3). The division of time into weeks of seven days each accounts for many instances of the occurrence of this number. This number has been called the symbol of perfection, and also the symbol of rest. 'Jacob's seven years' service to Laban; Pharaoh's seven fat oxen and seven lean ones; the seven branches of the golden candlestick; the seven trumpets and the seven priests who sounded them; the seven days' siege of Jericho; the seven churches, seven spirits, seven stars, seven seals, seven vials, and many others, sufficiently prove the importance of this sacred number' (see Lev. 25:4; 1 Sam. 2:5; Ps. 12:6; 79:12; Prov. 26:16; Isa. 4:1; Matt. 18:21, 22; Luke 17:4). The feast of Passover (Ex. 12:15, 16), the feast of Weeks (Deut. 16:9), of Tabernacles (13:15), and the Jubilee (Lev. 25:8), were all ordered by seven. Seven is the number of sacrifice (2 Chr. 29:21; Job 42:8), of purification and consecration (Lev. 42:6, 17; 8:11, 33; 14:9, 51), of forgiveness (Matt. 18:21, 22; Luke 17:4), of reward (Deut. 28:7; 1 Sam. 2:5), and of punishment (Lev. 26:21, 24, 28; Deut. 28:25). It is used for any round number in such passages as Job 5:19; Prov. 26:16, 25; Isa. 4:1; Matt. 12:45. It is used also to mean 'abundantly' (Gen. 4:15, 24; Lev. 26:24; Ps. 79:12).
definitionAm: ይህ ቁጥር በመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ምሳሌያዊ ትርጉም እንዳለው በሚያስገምቱ ሁኔታዎች ውስጥ ተጠቅሷል። በሰባተኛው ቀን እግዚአብሔር ዐረፈ፣ ቀደሰውም (ዘፍ. 2:2, 3)። ጊዜን በሰባት ቀናት ሳምንታት መከፋፈል ለዚህ ቁጥር መደጋገም ምክንያት ነው። ይህ ቁጥር የፍጹምነት እና የዕረፍት ምልክት ተብሎ ይጠራል። 'ያዕቆብ ለላባ ያገለገለባቸው ሰባት ዓመታት፤ የፈርዖን ሰባት የሰቡ ላሞችና ሰባት ከሲታ ላሞች፤ የሰባቱ ቅርንጫፎች የወርቅ መቅረዝ፤ ሰባቱ መለከቶችና የነፉአቸው ሰባት ካህናት፤ የሰባት ቀን የኢያሪኮ ከበባ፤ ሰባቱ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት፣ ሰባቱ መናፍስት፣ ሰባቱ ከዋክብት፣ ሰባቱ ማኅተሞች፣ ሰባቱ ጽዋዎች እና ሌሎችም የዚህን ቅዱስ ቁጥር አስፈላጊነት በበቂ ሁኔታ ያረጋግጣሉ' (ዘሌ. 25:4፤ 1 ሳሙ. 2:5፤ መዝ. 12:6፤ 79:12፤ ምሳሌ 26:16፤ ኢሳ. 4:1፤ ማቴ. 18:21, 22፤ ሉቃስ 17:4 ይመልከቱ)። የፋሲካ በዓል (ዘጸ. 12:15, 16)፣ የሳምንታት በዓል (ዘዳ. 16:9)፣ የዳስ በዓል (13:15) እና ኢዮቤልዩ (ዘሌ. 25:8) ሁሉም በሰባት የታዘዙ ነበሩ። ሰባት የመስዋዕት (2 ዜና 29:21፤ ኢዮብ 42:8)፣ የማንጻትና የቀድሶ (ዘሌ. 42:6፣ 17፤ 8:11፣ 33፤ 14:9፣ 51)፣ የይቅርታ (ማቴ. 18:21፣ 22፤ ሉቃስ 17:4)፣ የሽልማት (ዘዳ. 28:7፤ 1 ሳሙ. 2:5) እና የቅጣት (ዘሌ. 26:21፣ 24፣ 28፤ ዘዳ. 28:25) ቁጥር ነው። እንደ ኢዮብ 5:19፤ ምሳሌ 26:16፣ 25፤ ኢሳ. 4:1፤ ማቴ. 12:45 ባሉ ጥቅሶች ላይ ለማንኛውም ሙሉ ቁጥር ያገለግላል። እንዲሁም 'በብዛት' ለማለት ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል (ዘፍ. 4:15፣ 24፤ ዘሌ. 26:24፤ መዝ. 79:12)።

definition: A prophetic period mentioned in Dan. 9:24, and usually interpreted on the 'year-day' theory, i.e., reckoning each day for a year. This period will thus represent 490 years. This is regarded as the period which would elapse till the time of the coming of the Messiah, dating 'from the going forth of the commandment to restore and rebuild Jerusalem' i.e., from the close of the Captivity.
definitionAm: በዳን. 9:24 ላይ የተጠቀሰ ትንቢታዊ ጊዜ ሲሆን፣ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በ'ቀን ለዓመት' ንድፈ ሃሳብ ይተረጎማል፣ ይኸውም እያንዳንዱን ቀን እንደ አንድ ዓመት በመቁጠር ነው። ስለሆነም ይህ ጊዜ 490 ዓመታትን ይወክላል። ይህም መሲሑ እስከሚመጣበት ጊዜ ድረስ ያለውን ጊዜ እንደሆነ ተደርጎ ይቆጠራል፣ ይህም የሚጀምረው 'ኢየሩሳሌምን ለመመለስና ለመሥራት ትእዛዙ ከወጣበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ' ማለትም ከምርኮ ማብቂያ ጀምሮ ነው።

definition: Or Shaal'bim, a place of foxes, a town of the tribe of Dan (Josh. 19:42; Judg. 1:35). It was one of the chief towns from which Solomon drew his supplies (1 Kings 4:9). It is probably the modern village of Selbit, 3 miles north of Ajalon.
definitionAm: ወይም ሻልቢም፣ የቀበሮዎች ቦታ፣ በዳን ነገድ ውስጥ ያለች ከተማ (ኢያሱ 19:42፤ መሳ. 1:35)። ሰለሞን ስንቅ ከሚያገኝባቸው ዋና ዋና ከተሞች አንዷ ነበረች (1 ነገሥት 4:9)። ምናልባት ከአያሎን በስተሰሜን 3 ማይል ርቀት ላይ የምትገኘው የአሁኗ ሰልቢት መንደር ሳይሆን አይቀርም።

definition: Two gates. (1.) A city in the plain of Judah (1 Sam. 17:52); called also Sharaim (Josh. 15:36). (2.) A town in Simeon (1 Chr. 4:31).
definitionAm: ሁለት በሮች። (1.) በይሁዳ ሜዳ ላይ ያለች ከተማ (1 ሳሙ. 17:52)፤ ሻራይም ተብላም ትጠራለች (ኢያሱ 15:36)። (2.) በስምዖን ነገድ ያለች ከተማ (1 ዜና 4:31)።

definition: Servant of the beautiful, a chief eunuch in the second house of the harem of king Ahasuerus (Esther 2:14).
definitionAm: የቆንጆዎች አገልጋይ፣ በንጉሥ አርጤክስስ የሴቶች መኖሪያ ሁለተኛ ቤት ውስጥ የነበረ የጃንደረቦች አለቃ (አስቴር 2:14)።

definition: Sabbath-born, a Levite who assisted in expounding the law and investigating into the illegal marriages of the Jews (Ezra 10:15; Neh. 8:7; 11:16).
definitionAm: በሰንበት የተወለደ፣ ሕጉን በመተርጎም እና የአይሁዶችን ሕገ-ወጥ ጋብቻ በመመርመር ረገድ የረዳ ሌዋዊ (ዕዝራ 10:15፤ ነህ. 8:7፤ 11:16)።

definition: The Omnipotent, the name of God in frequent use in the Hebrew Scriptures, generally translated 'the Almighty.'
definitionAm: ሁሉን ቻይ፣ በዕብራይስጥ ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል የእግዚአብሔር ስም፣ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ 'ሁሉን ቻይ' ተብሎ ይተረጎማል።

definition: Used in Col. 2:17; Heb. 8:5; 10:1 to denote the typical relation of the Jewish to the Christian dispensation.
definitionAm: በቆላ. 2:17፤ ዕብ. 8:5፤ 10:1 ላይ በአይሁድ እና በክርስቲያን ሥርዓት መካከል ያለውን ምሳሌያዊ ዝምድና ለመግለጽ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል።

definition: Aku's command, the Chaldean name given to Hananiah, one of the Hebrew youths whom Nebuchadnezzar carried captive to Babylon (Dan. 1:6, 7; 3:12-30). He and his two companions refused to bow down before the image which Nebuchadnezzar had set up on the plains of Dura. Their conduct filled the king with the greatest fury, and he commanded them to be cast into the burning fiery furnace. Here, amid the fiery flames, they were miraculously preserved from harm. Over them the fire had no power, 'neither was a hair of their head singed, neither had the smell of fire passed on them.' Thus Nebuchadnezzar learned the greatness of the God of Israel. (See [574]ABEDNEGO.)
definitionAm: የአኩ ትዕዛዝ፤ ናቡከደነጾር ማርኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ለወሰዳቸው ዕብራውያን ወጣቶች አንዱ ለሆነው ለአናንያ የተሰጠ የከለዳውያን ስም (ዳን. 1፡6፣ 7፤ 3፡12-30)። እርሱና ሁለቱ ጓደኞቹ ናቡከደነጾር በዱራ ሜዳ ላይ ላቆመው ምስል ለመስገድ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ተግባራቸው ንጉሡን በታላቅ ቁጣ ሞላው፣ እናም በሚነድ የእሳት እቶን ውስጥ እንዲጣሉ አዘዘ። እዚህም፣ በነበልባሉ መካከል፣ በተአምር ከጉዳት ተጠበቁ። እሳቱ በእነርሱ ላይ ምንም ኃይል አልነበረውም፣ “የራሳቸው ጠጉር አልተቃጠለም፣ ልብሳቸውም አልተለወጠም፣ የእሳቱም ሽታ አልደረሰባቸውም።” በዚህም ናቡከደነጾር የእስራኤልን አምላክ ታላቅነት ተማረ። (አብደናጎን ይመልከቱ።)

definition: Perfect, a place (probably the village of Salim) some 2 miles east of Jacob's well. There is an abundant supply of water, which may have been the reason for Jacob's settling at this place (Gen. 33:18-20). The Revised Version translates this word, and reads, 'Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem,' thus not regarding it as a proper name at all.
definitionAm: ፍጹም፤ ከያዕቆብ የውኃ ጉድጓድ በስተምስራቅ 2 ማይል ያህል ርቆ የሚገኝ ቦታ (ምናልባትም የሳሊም መንደር)። እዚያ የተትረፈረፈ የውኃ አቅርቦት አለ፣ ይህም ያዕቆብ በዚህ ቦታ ለመስፈር ምክንያት ሳይሆን አይቀርም (ዘፍ. 33፡18-20)። የተሻሻለው እትም ይህን ቃል “ያዕቆብ በሰላም ወደ ሴኬም ከተማ መጣ” በማለት ይተረጉመዋል፣ በዚህም እንደ ትክክለኛ ስም አይቆጥረውም።

definition: Land of foxes, a place apparently to the north-west of Jerusalem (1 Sam. 9:4), perhaps in the neighbourhood of Shaalabbin in Dan (Josh. 19:42).
definitionAm: የቀበሮዎች ምድር፤ ከኢየሩሳሌም በስተሰሜን ምዕራብ የሚገኝ ቦታ (1 ሳሙ. 9፡4)፣ ምናልባትም በዳን ውስጥ በሸዓለቢን አቅራቢያ (ኢያሱ 19፡42)።

definition: Probably the district of Baal-shalisha (2 Kings 4:42), lying about 12 miles north of Lydda (1 Sam. 9:4).
definitionAm: ምናልባት ከሊዳ በስተሰሜን 12 ማይል ያህል ርቆ የሚገኘው የበኣል-ሻሊሻ አውራጃ (2 ነገሥት 4፡42) ሳይሆን አይቀርም (1 ሳሙ. 9፡4)።

definition: I.e., 'the gate of casting out,' hence supposed to be the refuse gate; one of the gates of the house of the Lord, 'by the causeway of the going up' i.e., the causeway rising up from the Tyropoeon valley = valley of the cheesemakers (1 Chr. 26:16).
definitionAm: ማለትም “የመጣል በር”፣ ስለዚህም የቆሻሻ መጣያ በር እንደሆነ ይታሰባል፤ “በመውጫው መንገድ አጠገብ” ካሉት የእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሮች አንዱ ነው፣ ማለትም ከቲሮፒዮን ሸለቆ = ከአይብ ሠሪዎች ሸለቆ ወደ ላይ የሚወጣው መንገድ (1 ዜና 26፡16)።

definition: Retribution. (1.) The son of Jabesh, otherwise unknown. He 'conspired against Zachariah, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead' (2 Kings 15:10). He reigned only 'a month of days in Samaria' (15:13, marg.). Menahem rose up against Shallum and put him to death (2 Kings 15:14, 15, 17), and became king in his stead. (2.) Keeper of the temple vestments in the reign of Josiah (2 Kings 22:14). (3.) One of the posterity of Judah (1 Chr. 2:40, 41). (4.) A descendant of Simeon (1 Chr. 4:25). (5.) One of the line of the high priests (1 Chr. 6:13). (6.) 1 Chr. 7:13. (7.) A keeper of the gate in the reign of David (1 Chr. 9:17). (8.) A Levite porter (1 Chr. 9:19, 31; Jer. 35:4). (9.) An Ephraimite chief (2 Chr. 28:12). (10.) The uncle of the prophet Jeremiah (Jer. 32:7). (11.) A son of king Josiah (1 Chr. 3:15; Jer. 22:11), who was elected to succeed his father on the throne, although he was two years younger than his brother Eliakim. He assumed the crown under the name of Jehoahaz (q.v.). He did not imitate the example of his father (2 Kings 23:32), but was 'a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men' (Ezek. 19:3). His policy was anti-Egyptian therefore. Necho, at that time at Riblah, sent an army against Jerusalem, which at once yielded, and Jehoahaz was carried captive to the Egyptian camp, Eliakim being appointed king in his stead. He remained a captive in Egypt till his death, and was the first king of Judah that died in exile.
definitionAm: ቅጣት። (1.) የኢያቢስ ልጅ፤ በሌላ መልኩ አይታወቅም። እርሱ “በዘካርያስ ላይ ተማማለ፣ በሕዝብም ፊት መታውና ገደለው፣ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ” (2 ነገሥት 15፡10)። በሰማርያ የነገሠው “አንድ ወር ብቻ” ነበር (15፡13)። ምናሔም በሻሉም ላይ ተነሥቶ ገደለው (2 ነገሥት 15፡14፣ 15፣ 17)፣ በእርሱም ፋንታ ንጉሥ ሆነ። (2.) በኢዮስያስ ዘመን የቤተ መቅደስ ልብስ ጠባቂ (2 ነገሥት 22፡14)። (3.) ከይሁዳ ዘር አንዱ (1 ዜና 2፡40፣ 41)። (4.) የስምዖን ዘር (1 ዜና 4፡25)። (5.) ከሊቀ ካህናት መስመር አንዱ (1 ዜና 6፡13)። (6.) 1 ዜና 7፡13። (7.) በዳዊት ዘመን የበር ጠባቂ (1 ዜና 9፡17)። (8.) ሌዋዊ በረኛ (1 ዜና 9፡19፣ 31፤ ኤር. 35፡4)። (9.) የኤፍሬም አለቃ (2 ዜና 28፡12)። (10.) የነቢዩ ኤርምያስ አጎት (ኤር. 32፡7)። (11.) የንጉሥ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ (1 ዜና 3፡15፤ ኤር. 22፡11)፣ ከወንድሙ ከኤልያቄም በሁለት ዓመት ቢያንስም አባቱን ተክቶ እንዲነግሥ ተመረጠ። በኢዮአካዝ ስም ዘውድ ጫነ። የአባቱን ምሳሌ አልተከተለም (2 ነገሥት 23፡32)፣ ነገር ግን “ደቦል አንበሳ ነበረ፣ ንጥቂያንም ተማረ፣ ሰዎችንም በላ” (ሕዝ. 19፡3)። ስለዚህ ፖሊሲው የግብፅ ተቃዋሚ ነበር። በዚያን ጊዜ በሪብላ የነበረው ኒካዑ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሠራዊት ላከ፣ ኢየሩሳሌምም ወዲያው እጅ ሰጠች፣ ኢዮአካዝም ተማርኮ ወደ ግብፅ ሰፈር ተወሰደ፣ ኤልያቄም በእርሱ ፋንታ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ተሾመ። እስኪሞት ድረስ በግብፅ በምርኮ ቆየ፣ በስደት የሞተ የመጀመሪያው የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ነበር።

definition: An Assyrian king (Hos. 10:14), identified with Shalmaneser II. (Sayce) or IV. (Lenormant), the successor of Pul on the throne of Assyria (B.C. 728). He made war against Hoshea, the king of Israel, whom he subdued and compelled to pay an annual tribute. Hoshea, however, soon after rebelled against his Assyrian conquerer. Shalmaneser again marched against Samaria, which, after a siege of three years, was taken (2 Kings 17:3-5; 18:9) by Sargon (q.v.). A revolution meantime had broken out in Assyria, and Shalmaneser was deposed. Sargon usurped the vacant throne. Schrader thinks that this is probably the name of a king of Moab mentioned on an inscription of Tiglath-pileser as Salamanu.
definitionAm: የአሦር ንጉሥ (ሆሴዕ 10፡14)፣ ከሻልማኔዘር ዳግማዊ ወይም አራተኛ ጋር የሚለይ፣ በአሦር ዙፋን ላይ የፉል ተተኪ (728 ዓ.ዓ.)። በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በሆሴዕ ላይ ጦርነት ከፈተ፣ ድል አድርጎም ዓመታዊ ግብር እንዲከፍል አስገደደው። ሆሴዕ ግን ብዙም ሳይቆይ በአሦር አሸናፊው ላይ ዓመፀ። ሻልማኔዘር እንደገና ወደ ሰማርያ ዘመተ፣ ከሦስት ዓመት ከበባ በኋላም በሳርጎን ተያዘች (2 ነገሥት 17፡3-5፤ 18፡9)። በዚያው ልክ በአሦር ውስጥ አብዮት ተቀስቅሶ ሻልማኔዘር ከሥልጣን ወረደ። ሳርጎን ባዶውን ዙፋን ወረሰ። ሽራደር ይህ ምናልባት በቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር ጽሑፍ ላይ ሰላማኑ ተብሎ የተጠቀሰው የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ስም ሊሆን ይችላል ብሎ ያስባል።

definition: The Philistines from the maritime plain had made incursions into the Hebrew upland for the purposes of plunder, when one of this name, the son of Anath, otherwise unknown, headed a rising for the purpose of freeing the land from this oppression. He repelled the invasion, slaying 600 men with an 'ox goad' (q.v.). The goad was a formidable sharpointed instrument, sometimes ten feet long. He was probably contemporary for a time with Deborah and Barak (Judg. 3:31; 5:6).
definitionAm: ፍልስጥኤማውያን ለዝርፊያ ዓላማ ወደ ዕብራውያን ደጋማ ቦታዎች ወረራ አድርገው በነበረበት ጊዜ፣ የዓናት ልጅ የሆነውና በሌላ ሁኔታ የማይታወቀው ይህ ሰው፣ ምድሪቱን ከዚህ ጭቆና ነፃ ለማውጣት አመጽ መራ። ወረራውን በመመከት 600 ሰዎችን በ“በሬ መውጊያ” ገደለ። መውጊያው አስፈሪና ሹል የሆነ መሣሪያ ሲሆን አንዳንዴም አሥር ጫማ ርዝመት ነበረው። እርሱ ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ከዲቦራ እና ከባርቅ ጋር በዘመኑ የነበረ ሳይሆን አይቀርም (መሳ. 3፡31፤ 5፡6)።

definition: A sharp thorn. (1.) One of the sons of Michah (1 Chr. 24:24). (2.) A town among the mountains of Judah (Josh. 15:48); probably Somerah, 2 1/2 miles north-west of Debir. (3.) The residence of Tola, one of the judges, on Mount Ephraim (Judg. 10:1, 2).
definitionAm: ሹል እሾህ። (1.) የሚካ ልጆች አንዱ (1 ዜና 24፡24)። (2.) በይሁዳ ተራሮች መካከል ያለች ከተማ (ኢያሱ 15፡48)፤ ምናልባትም ከዳቤር በስተሰሜን ምዕራብ 2 1/2 ማይል ርቃ የምትገኝ ሶሜራህ ናት። (3.) ከመሳፍንት አንዱ የሆነው ቶላ በኤፍሬም ተራራ ላይ የኖረበት ቦታ (መሳ. 10፡1፣ 2)።

definition: Desert. (1.) One of the 'dukes' of Edom (Gen. 36:13, 17). (2.) One of the sons of Jesse (1 Sam. 16:9). He is also called Shimeah (2 Sam. 13:3) and Shimma (1 Chr. 2:13). (3.) One of David's three mighty men (2 Sam. 23:11, 12). (4.) One of David's mighties (2 Sam. 23:25); called also Shammoth (1 Chr. 11:27) and Shamhuth (27:8).
definitionAm: በረሃ። (1.) ከኤዶም መኳንንት አንዱ (ዘፍ. 36፡13፣ 17)። (2.) የእሴይ ልጆች አንዱ (1 ሳሙ. 16፡9)። እርሱም ሳሚ (2 ሳሙ. 13፡3) እና ሺምዓ (1 ዜና 2፡13) ተብሎም ይጠራል። (3.) ከዳዊት ሦስት ኃያላን ሰዎች አንዱ (2 ሳሙ. 23፡11፣ 12)። (4.) ከዳዊት ኃያላን አንዱ (2 ሳሙ. 23፡25)፤ ደግሞም ሻሞት (1 ዜና 11፡27) እና ሻምሁት (27፡8) ተብሎ ይጠራል።

definition: Heard. (1.) One of the spies sent out by Moses to search the land (Num. 13:4). He represented the tribe of Reuben. (2.) One of David's sons (1 Chr. 14:4; 3:5, 'Shimea;' 2 Sam. 5:14). (3.) A Levite under Nehemiah (11:17).
definitionAm: የተሰማ። (1.) ምድሪቱን እንዲሰልሉ በሙሴ ከተላኩት ሰላዮች አንዱ (ዘሁ. 13፡4)። እርሱ የሮቤልን ነገድ ወክሏል። (2.) የዳዊት ልጆች አንዱ (1 ዜና 14፡4፤ 3፡5፣ “ሺምዓ፤” 2 ሳሙ. 5፡14)። (3.) በነህምያ ዘመን የነበረ ሌዋዊ (11፡17)።

definition: A coney, a scribe or secretary of king Josiah (2 Kings 22:3-7). He consulted Huldah concerning the newly-discovered copy of the law which was delivered to him by Hilkiah the priest (8-14). His grandson Gedaliah was governor of Judea (25:22).
definitionAm: ሽኮኮ፤ የንጉሥ ኢዮስያስ ጸሐፊ ወይም ጸሐፊ (2 ነገሥት 22፡3-7)። ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ ስለሰጠው አዲስ ስለተገኘው የሕግ መጽሐፍ ቅጂ ሕልዳናን አማከረ (8-14)። የልጅ ልጁ ገዳልያ የይሁዳ ገዥ ነበረ (25፡22)።

definition: Judge. (1.) One of the spies. He represented the tribe of Simeon (Num. 13:5). (2.) The father of Elisha (1 Kings 19:16-19). (3.) One of David's chief herdsmen (1 Chr. 27:29).
definitionAm: ፈራጅ። (1.) ከሰላዮች አንዱ። የስምዖንን ነገድ ወክሏል (ዘሁ. 13፡5)። (2.) የኤልሳዕ አባት (1 ነገሥት 19፡16-19)። (3.) ከዳዊት ዋና የእንሰሳት ጠባቂዎች አንዱ (1 ዜና 27፡29)።

definition: Brightness, one of the stations where Israel encamped in the wilderness (Num. 33:23, 24).
definitionAm: ብሩህነት፤ እስራኤላውያን በምድረ በዳ ከሰፈሩባቸው ቦታዎች አንዱ (ዘሁ. 33፡23፣ 24)።

definition: Two gates (Josh. 15:36), more correctly Shaaraim (1 Sam. 17:52), probably Tell Zakariya and Kefr Zakariya, in the valley of Elah, 3 1/2 miles north-west of Socoh.
definitionAm: ሁለት በሮች (ኢያሱ 15፡36)፣ ይበልጥ በትክክል ሸዓረይም (1 ሳሙ. 17፡52)፣ ምናልባትም ከሦኮ በስተሰሜን ምዕራብ 3 1/2 ማይል ርቆ በሚገኘው በኤላ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ቴል ዘካሪያ እና ኬፍር ዘካሪያ።

definition: (god) protect the king!, a son of Sennacherib, king of Assyria. He and his brother Adrammelech murdered their father, and then fled into the land of Armenia (2 Kings 19:37).
definitionAm: (አምላክ) ንጉሡን ይጠብቅ! የአሦር ንጉሥ የሰናክሬም ልጅ። እርሱና ወንድሙ አድራማሌክ አባታቸውን ገድለው ወደ አርሜኒያ ምድር ሸሹ (2 ነገሥት 19፡37)።

definition: A plain, a level tract extending from the Mediterranean to the hill country to the west of Jerusalem, about 30 miles long and from 8 to 15 miles broad, celebrated for its beauty and fertility (1 Chr. 27:29; Isa. 33:9; 35:2; 65:10). The 'rose of Sharon' is celebrated (Cant. 2:1). It is called Lasharon (the article la being here a part of the word) in Josh. 12:18.
definitionAm: ሜዳ፤ ከሜዲትራኒያን ባሕር አንስቶ ከኢየሩሳሌም በስተምዕራብ እስከሚገኘው ኮረብታማ አገር የሚዘልቅ፣ 30 ማይል ያህል ርዝመት እና ከ8 እስከ 15 ማይል ስፋት ያለው፣ በውበቱና በፍሬያማነቱ የሚታወቅ ጠፍጣፋ መሬት (1 ዜና 27፡29፤ ኢሳ. 33፡9፤ 35፡2፤ 65፡10)። “የሳሮን ጽጌረዳ” ዝነኛ ነው (መኃልየ 2፡1)። በኢያሱ 12፡18 ላይ ላሳሮን ተብሎ ተጠርቷል (እዚህ ላይ ‘ላ’ የሚለው መስተፃምር የቃሉ አካል ነው)።

definition: Plain of Kirja-thaim where Chedorlaomer defeated the Emims, the original inhabitants (Gen. 14:5). Now Kureiyat, north of Dibon, in the land of Moab.
definitionAm: ኮሎዶጎሞር የቀድሞ ነዋሪዎችን ኤሚማውያንን ድል ያደረገበት የቂርያታይም ሜዳ (ዘፍ. 14፡5)። አሁን በሞዓብ ምድር ከዲቦን በስተሰሜን የሚገኘው ኩሬያት ነው።

definition: Valley of the plain the ancient name of the 'king's dale' (q.v.), or Kidron, on the north side of Jerusalem (Gen. 14:17).

definition: An oath, seven. (1.) Heb. shebha, the son of Raamah (Gen. 10:7), whose descendants settled with those of Dedan on the Persian Gulf. (2.) Heb. id. A son of Joktan (Gen. 10:28), probably the founder of the Sabeans. (3.) Heb. id. A son of Jokshan, who was a son of Abraham by Keturah (Gen. 25:3). (4.) Heb. id. A kingdom in Arabia Felix. Sheba, in fact, was Saba in Southern Arabia, the Sabaeans of classical geography, who carried on the trade in spices with the other peoples of the ancient world. They were Semites, speaking one of the two main dialects of Himyaritic or South Arabic. Sheba had become a monarchy before the days of Solomon. Its queen brought him gold, spices, and precious stones (1 Kings 10:1-13). She is called by our Lord the 'queen of the south' (Matt. 12:42). (5.) Heb. shebha', 'seven' or 'an oak.' A town of Simeon (Josh. 19:2). (6.) Heb. id. A 'son of Bichri,' of the family of Becher, the son of Benjamin, and thus of the stem from which Saul was descended (2 Sam. 20:1-22). When David was returning to Jerusalem after the defeat of Absalom, a strife arose between the ten tribes and the tribe of Judah, because the latter took the lead in bringing back the king. Sheba took advantage of this state of things, and raised the standard of revolt, proclaiming, 'We have no part in David.' With his followers he proceeded northward. David seeing it necessary to check this revolt, ordered Abishai to take the gibborim, 'mighty men,' and the body-guard and such troops as he could gather, and pursue Sheba. Joab joined the expedition, and having treacherously put Amasa to death, assumed the command of the army. Sheba took refuge in Abel-Bethmaachah, a fortified town some miles north of Lake Merom. While Joab was engaged in laying siege to this city, Sheba's head was, at the instigation of a 'wise woman' who had held a parley with him from the city walls, thrown over the wall to the besiegers, and thus the revolt came to an end.
definitionAm: መሐላ፣ ሰባት። (1.) የራዕማ ልጅ (ዘፍ. 10፡7)፣ ዘሮቹ ከድዳን ጋር በፋርስ ባሕረ ሰላጤ ላይ ሰፈሩ። (2.) የዮቅጣን ልጅ (ዘፍ. 10፡28)፣ ምናልባትም የሳባውያን መስራች። (3.) አብርሃም ከኬጡራ የወለደው የዮቅሳን ልጅ (ዘፍ. 25፡3)። (4.) በደቡብ ዓረብ የሚገኝ መንግሥት። ሳባ በጥንታዊ ጂኦግራፊ ከሌሎች የዓለም ሕዝቦች ጋር የቅመማ ቅመም ንግድ ያካሂዱ የነበሩ ሳባውያን ናቸው። በሰሎሞን ዘመን መንግሥት ነበረች። ንግሥቷ ወርቅ፣ ቅመምና የከበሩ ድንጋዮችን አመጣችለት (1 ነገሥት 10፡1-13)። ጌታችን “የደቡብ ንግሥት” ብሎ ጠርቷታል (ማቴ. 12፡42)። (5.) የስምዖን ከተማ (ኢያሱ 19፡2)። (6.) የቢክሪ ልጅ፣ ከብንያም ወገን የሆነ፣ ሳኦል ከወጣበት ግንድ የተወለደ (2 ሳሙ. 20፡1-22)። አቤሴሎም ድል ከተደረገ በኋላ ዳዊት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲመለስ፣ በይሁዳ ነገድ እና በአሥሩ ነገዶች መካከል ክርክር ተነሳ። ሳባ ይህንን አጋጣሚ በመጠቀም “በዳዊት ዘንድ ድርሻ የለንም” በማለት ዓመፅ አስነሳ። ዳዊት አቢሳንና ኢዮአብን ዓመፁን እንዲያቆሙ ላካቸው። ሳባ በአቤል-ቤት-መዓካ በተባለች ከተማ ተሸሸገ። ኢዮአብ ከተማዋን በከበበ ጊዜ አንዲት “ጥበበኛ ሴት” ባቀረበችው ምክር የሳባ ራስ በቅጥሩ ላይ ተጥሎ ዓመፁ አበቃ።

definition: Tender youth, 'treasurer' over the house in the reign of Hezekiah, i.e., comptroller or governor of the palace. On account of his pride he was ejected from his office, and Eliakim was promoted to it (Isa. 22:15-25). He appears to have been the leader of the party who favoured an alliance with Egypt against Assyria. It is conjectured that 'Shebna the scribe,' who was one of those whom the king sent to confer with the Assyrian ambassador (2 Kings 18:18, 26, 37; 19:2; Isa. 36:3, 11, 22; 37:2), was a different person.

definition: Shoulder. (1.) The son of Hamor the Hivite (Gen. 33:19; 34). (2.) A descendant of Manasseh (Num. 26:31; Josh. 17:2). (3.) A city in Samaria (Gen. 33:18), called also Sichem (12:6), Sychem (Acts 7:16). It stood in the narrow sheltered valley between Ebal on the north and Gerizim on the south, these mountains at their base being only some 500 yards apart. Here Abraham pitched his tent and built his first altar in the Promised Land, and received the first divine promise (Gen. 12:6, 7). Here also Jacob 'bought a parcel of a field at the hands of the children of Hamor' after his return from Mesopotamia, and settled with his household, which he purged from idolatry by burying the teraphim of his followers under an oak tree, which was afterwards called 'the oak of the sorcerer' (Gen. 33:19; 35:4; Judg. 9:37). Here too, after a while, he dug a well, which bears his name to this day (John 4:5, 39-42). To Shechem Joshua gathered all Israel 'before God,' and delivered to them his second parting address (Josh. 24:1-15). He 'made a covenant with the people that day' at the very place where, on first entering the land, they had responded to the law from Ebal and Gerizim (Josh. 24:25), the terms of which were recorded 'in the book of the law of God', i.e., in the roll of the law of Moses; and in memory of this solemn transaction a great stone was set up 'under an oak' (comp. Gen. 28:18; 31:44-48; Ex. 24:4; Josh. 4:3, 8, 9), possibly the old 'oak of Moreh,' as a silent witness of the transaction to all coming time. Shechem became one of the cities of refuge, the central city of refuge for Western Palestine (Josh. 20:7), and here the bones of Joseph were buried (24:32). Rehoboam was appointed king in Shechem (1 Kings 12:1, 19), but Jeroboam afterwards took up his residence here. This city is mentioned in connection with our Lord's conversation with the woman of Samaria (John 4:5); and thus, remaining as it does to the present day, it is one of the oldest cities of the world. It is the modern Nablus, a contraction for Neapolis, the name given to it by Vespasian. It lies about a mile and a half up the valley on its southern slope, and on the north of Gerizim, which rises about 1,100 feet above it, and is about 34 miles north of Jerusalem. It contains about 10,000 inhabitants, of whom about 160 are Samaritans and 100 Jews, the rest being Christians and Mohammedans. The site of Shechem is said to be of unrivalled beauty. Stanley says it is 'the most beautiful, perhaps the only very beautiful, spot in Central Palestine.' Gaza, near Shechem, only mentioned 1 Chr. 7:28, has entirely disappeared. It was destroyed at the time of the Conquest, and its place was taken by Shechem.
definitionAm: ከሻ፤ ትከሻ። (1.) የሀዊያዊው የኤሞር ልጅ (ዘፍ. 33:19፤ 34)። (2.) የምናሴ ዘር (ዘሁ. 26:31፤ ኢያሱ 17:2)። (3.) በሰማርያ ያለች ከተማ (ዘፍ. 33:18)፣ ሲኬም (12:6) ወይም ሲካር (ሐዋ. 7:16) ተብላም ትጠራለች። በሰሜን በኩል በጌባል እና በደቡብ በኩል በገሪዛን መካከል ባለው ጠባብ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። አብርሃም ድንኳኑን የተከለበትና በተስፋይቱ ምድር የመጀመሪያውን መሠዊያ የሠራበት፣ የመጀመሪያውንም መለኮታዊ ተስፋ የተቀበለበት ቦታ ነው (ዘፍ. 12:6, 7)። ያዕቆብም ከመሶጶታምያ ከተመለሰ በኋላ 'የእርሻውን ድርሻ ከኤሞር ልጆች እጅ የገዛበት' እና ተከታዮቹ የነበራቸውን ጣዖታት ከኦክ ዛፍ ሥር በመቅበር ቤተሰቡን ከጣዖት አምልኮ ያነጻበት ስፍራ ነው (ዘፍ. 33:19፤ 35:4፤ መሳ. 9:37)። እዚህም እስካሁን በስሙ የሚጠራውን ጉድጓድ ቆፍሯል (ዮሐንስ 4:5, 39-42)። ኢያሱም እስራኤልን ሁሉ 'በእግዚአብሔር ፊት' ወደ ሴኬም ሰብስቦ ሁለተኛውን የመለያያ ንግግሩን አደረገላቸው (ኢያሱ 24:1-15)። በዚያ ቀን ከሕዝቡ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ (ኢያሱ 24:25)። ሴኬም አንዷ የመማጸኛ ከተማ ሆነች (ኢያሱ 20:7)፣ የዮሴፍም አጥንት በዚያ ተቀበረ (24:32)። ሮብዓም በሴኬም ነገሠ (1 ነገሥት 12:1, 19)። ከተማዋ በጌታችን እና በሰማርያዊቷ ሴት ውይይት ውስጥ ተጠቅሳለች (ዮሐንስ 4:5)። በአሁኑ ጊዜ ናብሉስ ትባላለች።

definition: A Chaldee word meaning resting-place, not found in Scripture, but used by the later Jews to designate the visible symbol of God's presence in the tabernacle, and afterwards in Solomon's temple. When the Lord led Israel out of Egypt, he went before them 'in a pillar of a cloud.' This was the symbol of his presence with his people. For references made to it during the wilderness wanderings, see Ex. 14:20; 40:34-38; Lev. 9:23, 24; Num. 14:10; 16:19, 42. It is probable that after the entrance into Canaan this glory-cloud settled in the tabernacle upon the ark of the covenant in the most holy place. We have, however, no special reference to it till the consecration of the temple by Solomon, when it filled the whole house with its glory, so that the priests could not stand to minister (1 Kings 8:10-13; 2 Chr. 5:13, 14; 7:1-3). Probably it remained in the first temple in the holy of holies as the symbol of Jehovah's presence so long as that temple stood. It afterwards disappeared.
definitionAm: የማረፊያ ቦታ የሚል ትርጉም ያለው የከለዳውያን ቃል ሲሆን በቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት ውስጥ አይገኝም፤ ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን አይሁዶች በድንኳኑ ውስጥ እና በኋላም በሰሎሞን ቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ የእግዚአብሔር መገኘት የሚታይበትን ምልክት ለመግለጽ ይጠቀሙበት ነበር። ጌታ እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ሲያወጣቸው 'በደመና ዓምድ' ቀድሟቸው ይሄድ ነበር። ይህ ከሕዝቡ ጋር የመኖሩ ምልክት ነበር (ዘጸ. 14:20፤ 40:34-38፤ ዘሌ. 9:23, 24፤ ዘሁ. 14:10፤ 16:19, 42)። በሰሎሞን ቤተ መቅደስ ምርቃት ወቅት ቤቱን በክብር ስለሞላው ካህናቱ ሊያገለግሉ አልቻሉም ነበር (1 ነገሥት 8:10-13፤ 2 ዜና 5:13, 14፤ 7:1-3)።

definition: Are of different varieties. Probably the flocks of Abraham and Isaac were of the wild species found still in the mountain regions of Persia and Kurdistan. After the Exodus, and as a result of intercourse with surrounding nations, other species were no doubt introduced into the herds of the people of Israel. They are frequently mentioned in Scripture. The care of a shepherd over his flock is referred to as illustrating God's care over his people (Ps. 23:1, 2; 74:1; 77:20; Isa. 40:11; 53:6; John 10:1-5, 7-16). 'The sheep of Palestine are longer in the head than ours, and have tails from 5 inches broad at the narrowest part to 15 inches at the widest, the weight being in proportion, and ranging generally from 10 to 14 lbs., but sometimes extending to 30 lbs. The tails are indeed huge masses of fat' (Geikie's Holy Land, etc.). The tail was no doubt the 'rump' so frequently referred to in the Levitical sacrifices (Ex. 29:22; Lev. 3:9; 7:3; 9:19). Sheep-shearing was generally an occasion of great festivity (Gen. 31:19; 38:12, 13; 1 Sam. 25:4-8, 36; 2 Sam. 13:23-28).
definitionAm: የተለያዩ ዓይነቶች አሏቸው። የአብርሃም እና የይስሐቅ መንጋዎች አሁንም በፋርስ እና በኩርዲስታን ተራራማ አካባቢዎች የሚገኙ የዱር ዝርያዎች ሳይሆኑ አይቀሩም። ከመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ አንጻር የእረኛው ለመንጋው የሚያደርገው እንክብካቤ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ የሚያደርገውን እንክብካቤ ለማሳየት ተጠቅሷል (መዝ. 23:1, 2፤ 74:1፤ 77:20፤ ኢሳ. 40:11፤ 53:6፤ ዮሐንስ 10:1-5)። የፍልስጤም በጎች ረጅም ጭንቅላት ያላቸውና ጅራታቸው በጣም ወፍራም የሆነ ዝርያ ናቸው። ጅራቱ በዘሌዋውያን መሥዋዕት ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ የተጠቀሰው 'ላት' ሳይሆን አይቀርም (ዘጸ. 29:22፤ ዘሌ. 3:9)። የበግ ሸለቆ ጊዜ ከፍተኛ በዓል የሚከበርበት ወቅት ነበር (ዘፍ. 31:19፤ 1 ሳሙ. 25:4-8)።

definition: A strong fenced enclosure for the protection of the sheep gathered within it (Num. 32:24; 1 Chr. 17:7; Ps. 50:9; 78:70). In John 10:16 the Authorized Version renders by 'fold' two distinct Greek words, aule and poimne, the latter of which properly means a 'flock,' and is so rendered in the Revised Version. (See also Matt. 26:31; Luke 2:8; 1 Cor. 9:7.)
definitionAm: የተሰበሰቡትን በጎች ለመጠበቅ ታጥሮ የተሠራ ጠንካራ ግቢ (ዘሁ. 32:24፤ 1 ዜና 17:7፤ መዝ. 50:9፤ 78:70)። በዮሐንስ 10፡16 ላይ 'በረት' የሚለው ቃል ሁለት የተለያዩ ትርጉሞችን ሊይዝ ይችላል፤ አንዱ በረቱን ሲያመለክት ሌላው ደግሞ መንጋውን ያመለክታል።

definition: One of the gates of Jerusalem mentioned by Nehemiah (3:1, 32; 12:39). It was in the eastern wall of the city.
definitionAm: በነህምያ (3:1, 32፤ 12:39) የተጠቀሰች ከኢየሩሳሌም በሮች አንዷ። በከተማዋ ምስራቃዊ ቅጥር በኩል ትገኝ ነበር።

definition: Occurs only in John 5:2 (marg., also R.V., 'sheep-gate'). The word so rendered is an adjective, and it is uncertain whether the noun to be supplied should be 'gate' or, following the Vulgate Version, 'pool.'
definitionAm: በዮሐንስ 5፡2 ላይ ብቻ የሚገኝ ቃል (አንዳንድ ትርጉሞች 'የበግ በር' ይሉታል)። ቃሉ ቅጽል ሲሆን በሩን ወይስ ኩሬውን እንደሚያመለክት በእርግጠኝነት አይታወቅም።

definition: Weight, the common standard both of weight and value among the Hebrews. It is estimated at 220 English grains, or a little more than half an ounce avoirdupois. The 'shekel of the sanctuary' (Ex. 30:13; Num. 3:47) was equal to twenty gerahs (Ezek. 45:12). There were shekels of gold (1 Chr. 21:25), of silver (1 Sam. 9:8), of brass (17:5), and of iron (7). When it became a coined piece of money, the shekel of gold was equivalent to about 2 pound of our money. Six gold shekels, according to the later Jewish system, were equal in value to fifty silver ones. The temple contribution, with which the public sacrifices were bought (Ex. 30:13; 2 Chr. 24:6), consisted of one common shekel, or a sanctuary half-shekel, equal to two Attic drachmas. The coin, a stater (q.v.), which Peter found in the fish's mouth paid this contribution for both him and Christ (Matt. 17:24, 27). A zuza, or quarter of a shekel, was given by Saul to Samuel (1 Sam. 9:8).
definitionAm: ክብደት፤ በዕብራውያን ዘንድ የተለመደ የክብደት እና የዋጋ መለኪያ። ግምቱም 220 የእንግሊዝ ግሬን ወይም ግማሽ አውንስ ገደማ ነው። 'የመቅደስ ሰቅል' (ዘጸ. 30:13፤ ዘሁ. 3:47) ከሃያ ጌራ ጋር እኩል ነበር (ሕዝ. 45:12)። የወርቅ (1 ዜና 21:25)፣ የብር (1 ሳሙ. 9:8)፣ የናስ (17:5) እና የብረት ሰቅሎች ነበሩ። ስድስት የወርቅ ሰቅሎች ከሃምሳ የብር ሰቅሎች ጋር እኩል ዋጋ ነበራቸው። ጴጥሮስ በዓሣው አፍ ውስጥ ያገኘው ሳንቲም (እስቴር) ለእርሱና ለክርስቶስ የመቅደሱን ግብር ለመክፈል አገልግሏል (ማቴ. 17:24, 27)።

definition: Petition. (1.) Judah's third son (Gen. 38:2, 5, 11, 14). (2.) A son of Arphaxad (1 Chr. 1:18).
definitionAm: ልመና። (1.) የይሁዳ ሦስተኛ ልጅ (ዘፍ. 38:2, 5, 11, 14)። (2.) የአርፋክስድ ልጅ (1 ዜና 1:18)።

definition: Whom Jehovah repays. (1.) Ezra 10:39. (2.) The father of Hananiah (Neh. 3:30). (3.) A priest in the time of Nehemiah (13:13). (4.) Father of one of those who accused Jeremiah to Zedekiah (Jer. 37:3; 38:1). (5.) Father of a captain of the ward (Jer. 37:13). (6.) Jer. 36:14.
definitionAm: እግዚአብሔር የሚከፍለው። (1.) ዕዝራ 10:39። (2.) የሐናንያ አባት (ነህ. 3:30)። (3.) በነህምያ ዘመን የነበረ ካህን (13:13)። (4.) ኤርምያስን በሴዴቅያስ ፊት ከከሰሱት ሰዎች የአንዱ አባት (ኤር. 37:3፤ 38:1)። (5.) የጥበቃ አለቃ አባት (ኤር. 37:13)። (6.) ኤር. 36:14።

definition: A name; renown, the first mentioned of the sons of Noah (Gen. 5:32; 6:10). He was probably the eldest of Noah's sons. The words 'brother of Japheth the elder' in Gen. 10:21 are more correctly rendered 'the elder brother of Japheth,' as in the Revised Version. Shem's name is generally mentioned first in the list of Noah's sons. He and his wife were saved in the ark (7:13). Noah foretold his preeminence over Canaan (9:23-27). He died at the age of six hundred years, having been for many years contemporary with Abraham, according to the usual chronology. The Israelitish nation sprang from him (Gen. 11:10-26; 1 Chr. 1:24-27).
definitionAm: ስም፤ ዝና፤ ከኖኅ ልጆች መካከል መጀመሪያ የተጠቀሰው (ዘፍ. 5:32፤ 6:10)። ምናልባትም የኖኅ የበኩር ልጅ ሊሆን ይችላል። በዘፍጥረት 10፡21 ላይ 'የታላቁ የያፌት ወንድም' የሚለው ቃል 'የያፌት ታላቅ ወንድም' ተብሎ ቢተረጎም ይበልጥ ትክክል ነው። እርሱና ሚስቱ በመርከብ ውስጥ ድነዋል (7:13)። ኖኅ በከነዓን ላይ ያለውን የበላይነት ተንብዮ ነበር (9:23-27)። በስድስት መቶ ዓመቱ ሞተ። የእስራኤል ብሔር ከእርሱ ተወለደ (ዘፍ. 11:10-26፤ 1 ዜና 1:24-27)።

definition: Rumour. (1.) A Reubenite (1 Chr. 5:8). (2.) A Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:13). (3.) One who stood by Ezra when he read the law (Neh. 8:4). (4.) A town in the south of Judah (Josh. 15:26); the same as Sheba (ver. 5).
definitionAm: ወሬ። (1.) የሮቤል ዘር (1 ዜና 5:8)። (2.) የብንያም ዘር (1 ዜና 8:13)። (3.) ዕዝራ ሕጉን ሲያነብ በአጠገቡ የቆመ ሰው (ነህ. 8:4)። (4.) በይሁዳ ደቡብ የምትገኝ ከተማ (ኢያሱ 15:26)፤ ከሳባ (ቁ. 5) ጋር አንድ ናት።

definition: Rumour, a Benjamite whose sons 'came to David to Ziklag' (1 Chr. 12:3).
definitionAm: ወሬ፤ ልጆቹ በጺቅላግ ወደ ዳዊት የመጡ የብንያም ሰው (1 ዜና 12:3)።

definition: Whom Jehovah heard. (1.) A prophet in the reign of Rehoboam (1 Kings 12:22-24). (2.) Neh. 3:29. (3.) A Simeonite (1 Chr. 4:37). (4.) A priest (Neh. 12:42). (5.) A Levite (1 Chr. 9:16). (6.) 1 Chr. 9:14; Neh. 11:15. (7.) A Levite in the time of David, who with 200 of his brethren took part in the bringing up of the ark from Obed-edom to Hebron (1 Chr. 15:8). (8.) A Levite (1 Chr. 24:6). (9.) The eldest son of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 26:4-8). (10.) A Levite (2 Chr. 29:14). (11.) A false prophet who hindered the rebuilding of Jerusalem (Neh. 6:10). (12.) A prince of Judah who assisted at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem (Neh. 12:34-36). (13.) A false prophet who opposed Jeremiah (Jer. 29:24-32). (14.) One of the Levites whom Jehoshaphat appointed to teach the law (2 Chr. 17:8). (15.) A Levite appointed to 'distribute the oblations of the Lord' (2 Chr. 31:15). (16.) A Levite (2 Chr. 35:9). (17.) The father of Urijah the prophet (Jer. 26:20). (18.) The father of a prince in the reign of Jehoiakim (Jer. 36:12).
definitionAm: እግዚአብሔር የሰማው። (1.) በሮብዓም ዘመን የነበረ ነቢይ (1 ነገ. 12:22-24)። (2.) ነህ. 3:29። (3.) የስምዖን ዘር (1 ዜና 4:37)። (4.) ካህን (ነህ. 12:42)። (5.) ሌዋዊ (1 ዜና 9:16)። (7.) የታቦቱን መምጣት በመምራት የተሳተፈ ሌዋዊ (1 ዜና 15:8)። (9.) የአቢዳራ የበኩር ልጅ (1 ዜና 26:4-8)። (11.) የኢየሩሳሌምን ግንባታ ያደናቀፈ ሐሰተኛ ነቢይ (ነህ. 6:10)። (13.) ኤርምያስን የተቃወመ ሐሰተኛ ነቢይ (ኤር. 29:24-32)።

definition: Whom Jehovah guards. (1.) One who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5). (2.) Ezra 10:32, 41.
definitionAm: እግዚአብሔር የሚጠብቀው። (1.) በጺቅላግ ወደ ዳዊት የመጣ ሰው (1 ዜና 12:5)። (2.) ዕዝራ 10:32, 41።

definition: Soaring on high, the king of Zeboiim, who joined with the other kings in casting off the yoke of Chedorlaomer. After having been reconquered by him, he was rescued by Abraham (Gen. 14:2).
definitionAm: ወደ ላይ መጥቀስ፤ የነነዌ (የጸቦይም) ንጉሥ፤ ከሌሎች ነገሥታት ጋር በመሆን የኮሎዶጎሞርን ቀንበር ለመጣል የተባበረ። በእርሱ ድል ከተነሳ በኋላ በአብርሃም አማካይነት ነጻ ወጣ (ዘፍ. 14:2)።

definition: Eight; octave, a musical term, supposed to denote the lowest note sung by men's voices (1 Chr. 15:21; Ps. 6; 12, title).

definition: Most high name. (1.) A Levite in the reign of Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:8). (2.) A Levite in David's time (1 Chr. 15:18, 20).

definitionAm: ከእግዚአብሔር የተሰማ። (1.) የዓሚሁድ ልጅ፤ ምድሪቱ ሲከፋፈል የስምዖንን ነገድ ወክሏል (ዘሁ. 34:20)። (2.) ለሳሙኤል መጠሪያ ሆኖ አገልግሏል (1 ዜና 6:33)። (3.) የይሳኮር ነገድ አለቃ (1 ዜና 7:2)።

definition: A tooth, probably some conspicuous tooth-shaped rock or crag (1 Sam. 7:12), a place between which and Mizpeh Samuel set up his 'Ebenezer.' In the Hebrew the word has the article prefixed, 'the Shen.' The site is unknown.
definitionAm: ጥርስ፤ ምናልባትም የጥርጥ ቅርጽ ያለው ድንጋይ ወይም ገደል (1 ሳሙ. 7:12)፤ ሳሙኤል በእርሱና በምጽጳ መካከል 'አቤንኤዘርን' የተከለበት ቦታ። ቦታው በውል አይታወቅም።

definition: (Heb., 'the all-demanding world' = Gr. Hades, 'the unknown region'), the invisible world of departed souls.
definitionAm: (በዕብራይስጥ 'ሁሉን ጠያቂው ዓለም' = በግሪክ ሲኦል 'የማይታወቀው ስፍራ')፤ የሙታን ነፍሳት የማይታይ ዓለም።

definitionAm: ዛፍ የሌለበት ቦታ፤ ዘሁልቁ 34፡10፣ 11፡- 'ወሰኑም ከሴፋም ወደ ሪብላ ይወርዳል።'

definition: Judged of the Lord. (1.) A son of David by Abital (2 Sam. 3:4). (2.) A Benjamite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5). (3.) A Simeonite prince in David's time (1 Chr. 27:16). (4.) One of Jehoshaphat's sons (2 Chr. 21:2). (5.) Ezra 2:4. (6.) Ezra 2:57; Neh. 7:59. (7.) One of the princes who urged the putting of Jeremiah to death (Jer. 38:1-4).
definitionAm: እግዚአብሔር ፈረደ። (1) ዳዊት ከአቢጣል የወለደው ልጅ (2 ሳሙ. 3፡4)። (2) በጺቅላግ ወደ ዳዊት የመጣ ብንያማዊ (1 ዜና 12፡5)። (3) በዳዊት ዘመን የስምዖን ነገድ አለቃ (1 ዜና 27፡16)። (4) ከኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች አንዱ (2 ዜና 21፡2)። (5) ዕዝራ 2፡4። (6) ዕዝራ 2፡57፤ ነህምያ 7፡59። (7) ኤርምያስ እንዲገደል ካሳሰቡት መኳንንት አንዱ (ኤር. 38፡1-4)።

definition: A word naturally of frequent occurence in Scripture. Sometimes the word 'pastor' is used instead (Jer. 2:8; 3:15; 10:21; 12:10; 17:16). This word is used figuratively to represent the relation of rulers to their subjects and of God to his people (Ps. 23:1; 80:1; Isa. 40:11; 44:28; Jer. 25:34, 35; Nahum 3:18; John 10:11, 14; Heb. 13:20; 1 Pet. 2:25; 5:4). The duties of a shepherd in an unenclosed country like Palestine were very onerous. 'In early morning he led forth the flock from the fold, marching at its head to the spot where they were to be pastured. Here he watched them all day, taking care that none of the sheep strayed, and if any for a time eluded his watch and wandered away from the rest, seeking diligently till he found and brought it back. In those lands sheep require to be supplied regularly with water, and the shepherd for this purpose has to guide them either to some running stream or to wells dug in the wilderness and furnished with troughs. At night he brought the flock home to the fold, counting them as they passed under the rod at the door to assure himself that none were missing. Nor did his labours always end with sunset. Often he had to guard the fold through the dark hours from the attack of wild beasts, or the wily attempts of the prowling thief (see 1 Sam. 17:34).', Deane's David.
definitionAm: በመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ የሚገኝ ቃል። አንዳንድ ጊዜ በምትኩ 'እረኛ' ወይም 'ጠባቂ' የሚለው ቃል ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል (ኤር. 2፡8፤ 3፡15፤ 10፡21፤ 12፡10፤ 17፡16)። ይህ ቃል በምሳሌያዊ ሁኔታ የገዥዎችን ለተገዥዎቻቸው ያለውን ግንኙነት እና የእግዚአብሔርን ለሕዝቡ ያለውን ግንኙነት ለመወከል ያገለግላል (መዝ. 23፡1፤ 80፡1፤ ኢሳ. 40፡11፤ 44፡28፤ ኤር. 25፡34፣ 35፤ ናሆም 3፡18፤ ዮሐንስ 10፡11፣ 14፤ ዕብ. 13፡20፤ 1 ጴጥ. 2፡25፤ 5፡4)። እንደ ፍልስጥኤም ባሉ ባልታጠሩ አገሮች የእረኛ ተግባራት በጣም ከባድ ነበሩ። 'በማለዳ መንጋውን ከበረት አውጥቶ ወደሚሰማሩበት ቦታ እየመራ ይሄዳል። እዚያም ቀኑን ሙሉ ይጠብቃቸዋል፣ አንዳቸውም እንዳይባዝኑ ጥንቃቄ ያደርጋል፣ ማንም ለጊዜው ከእይታው አምልጦ ከጠፋ እስኪያገኘው ድረስ በትጋት ፈልጎ ይመልሰዋል። በእነዚያ ምድሮች በጎች በመደበኛነት ውሃ ያስፈልጋቸዋል፣ እረኛውም ለዚህ ዓላማ ወይ ወደሚፈስ ወንዝ ወይም በምድረ በዳ ወደተቆፈሩና ገንዳ ወደተዘጋጀላቸው ጉድጓዶች ሊመራቸው ይገባል። ምሽት ላይ መንጋውን ወደ በረቱ ይመልሳል፣ አንዳቸውም እንዳይጠፉ ለማረጋገጥ በበሩ በኩል በበትር ስር ሲያልፉ ይቆጥራቸዋል። ስራው ሁልጊዜ በፀሐይ መግቢያ አያበቃም ነበር። ብዙ ጊዜ በጨለማ ሰዓታት በረቱን ከአራዊት ጥቃት ወይም ከሌባ ሙከራ መጠበቅ ነበረበት (1 ሳሙ. 17፡34 ይመልከቱ)።' ዲንስ ዴቪድ።

definitionAm: የእግዚአብሔር ነበልባል፤ በኢየሩሳሌም ዕዝራና ነህምያ በሚያከናውኑት ሥራ ስሙ በጉልህ የሚጠቀስ ካህን (ዕዝራ 8፡17፣ 18፣ 24-30፤ ነህ. 8፡7፤ 9፡4፣ 5፤ 10፡12)።

definition: (Dan. 3:2), Babylonian officers.
definitionAm: (ዳን. 3፡2) የባቢሎን የሥራ ኃላፊዎች (ሹማምንት)።

definition: (Jer. 25:26), supposed to be equivalent to Babel (Babylon), according to a secret (cabalistic) mode of writing among the Jews of unknown antiquity, which consisted in substituting the last letter of the Hebrew alphabet for the first, the last but one for the second, and so on. Thus the letters sh, sh, ch become b, b, l, i.e., Babel. This is supposed to be confirmed by a reference to Jer. 51:41, where Sheshach and Babylon are in parallel clauses. There seems to be no reason to doubt that Babylon is here intended by this name. (See Streane's Jeremiah, l.c.)
definitionAm: (ኤር. 25፡26)፤ አይሁድ ጥንት ይጠቀሙበት በነበረው በሚስጥራዊ የአጻጻፍ ዘዴ (ካባሊስቲክ) መሠረት ከባቢሎን ጋር እኩል እንደሆነ ይታሰባል፤ ይህም ዘዴ የመጀመሪያውን የዕብራይስጥ ፊደል በመጨረሻው፣ ሁለተኛውን ደግሞ ከመጨረሻው በፊት ባለው በመተካት የሚከናወን ነው። በዚህም መሠረት ሸ፣ ሸ፣ ኽ የሚሉት ፊደላት በ፣ በ፣ ል (ባቢሎን) ይሆናሉ። ይህ በኤርምያስ 51፡41 ላይ ሼሻክ እና ባቢሎን በትይዩ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ በመጠቀሳቸው የተረጋገጠ ይመስላል። ባቢሎን በዚህ ስም መጠራቷን ለመጠራጠር ምንም ምክንያት የለም።

definition: O sun-god, defend the lord! (Ezra 1:8, 11), probably another name for Zerubbabel (q.v.), Ezra 2:2; Hag. 1:12, 14; Zech. 4:6, 10.
definitionAm: የፀሐይ አምላክ ሆይ፣ ጌታውን ጠብቅ! (ዕዝራ 1፡8፣ 11)፤ ምናልባትም የዘሩባቤል ሌላ ስም ሊሆን ይችላል (ዕዝራ 2፡2፤ ሐጌ 1፡12፣ 14፤ ዘካ. 4፡6፣ 10)።

definition: Heb. Shebher. (1.) The son of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:49). (2.) Heb. Sheva', one of David's scribes (2 Sam. 20:25).
definitionAm: በዕብራይስጥ ሼቤር። (1) የካሌብ ልጅ (1 ዜና 2፡49)። (2) በዕብራይስጥ ሼቫ፤ ከዳዊት ጸሐፊዎች አንዱ (2 ሳሙ. 20፡25)።

definition: Ex. 25:30 (R.V. marg., 'presence bread'); 1 Chr. 9:32 (marg., 'bread of ordering'); Num. 4:7: called 'hallowed bread' (R.V., 'holy bread') in 1 Sam. 21:1-6. This bread consisted of twelve loaves made of the finest flour. They were flat and thin, and were placed in two rows of six each on a table in the holy place before the Lord. They were renewed every Sabbath (Lev. 24:5-9), and those that were removed to give place to the new ones were to be eaten by the priests only in the holy place (see 1 Sam. 21:3-6; comp. Matt. 12:3, 4). The number of the loaves represented the twelve tribes of Israel, and also the entire spiritual Israel, 'the true Israel;' and the placing of them on the table symbolized the entire consecration of Israel to the Lord, and their acceptance of God as their God. The table for the bread was made of acacia wood, 3 feet long, 18 inches broad, and 2 feet 3 inches high. It was plated with pure gold. Two staves, plated with gold, passed through golden rings, were used for carrying it.
definitionAm: ዘጸ. 25፡30፤ 1 ዜና 9፡32፤ ዘሁ. 4፡7፤ በ1 ሳሙ. 21፡1-6 ላይ 'የተቀደሰ ኅብስት' ተብሎ ተጠርቷል። ይህ ኅብስት በጥሩ ዱቄት የተሠሩ አሥራ ሁለት እንጀራዎችን የያዘ ነው። እነዚህም ጠፍጣፋና ስስ ሆነው በሁለት ረድፍ ስድስት ስድስት ሆነው በጌታ ፊት በቅድስት ስፍራ በሚገኝ ጠረጴዛ ላይ ይቀመጡ ነበር። በየሰንበቱ ይታደሱ ነበር (ዘሌ. 24፡5-9)፣ ለአዲሶቹ ቦታ ለመልቀቅ የተነሱትም በካህናቱ ብቻ በቅድስት ስፍራ ይበሉ ነበር (1 ሳሙ. 21፡3-6፤ ማቴ. 12፡3፣ 4)። የኅብስቶቹ ብዛት አሥራ ሁለቱን የእስራኤል ነገዶች፣ እንዲሁም መላውን መንፈሳዊ እስራኤል፣ 'እውነተኛውን እስራኤል' ይወክላል፤ በጠረጴዛው ላይ ማስቀመጣቸውም እስራኤል ሙሉ በሙሉ ለጌታ መመረጣቸውን እና እግዚአብሔርን አምላካቸው አድርገው መቀበላቸውን ያመለክታል። የኅብስቱ ጠረጴዛ ከግራር እንጨት የተሠራ ሆኖ 3 ጫማ ርዝመት፣ 18 ኢንች ስፋት እና 2 ጫማ ከ3 ኢንች ከፍታ ነበረው። በንጹሕ ወርቅ የተለበጠ ነበር። ለመሸከም የሚያገለግሉ በወርቅ የተለበጡ ሁለት መሎጊያዎች በወርቅ ቀለበቶች ውስጥ ያልፉ ነበር።

definition: River, or an ear of corn. The tribes living on the east of Jordan, separated from their brethren on the west by the deep ravines and the rapid river, gradually came to adopt peculiar customs, and from mixing largely with the Moabites, Ishmaelites, and Ammonites to pronounce certain letters in such a manner as to distinguish them from the other tribes. Thus when the Ephraimites from the west invaded Gilead, and were defeated by the Gileadites under the leadership of Jephthah, and tried to escape by the 'passages of the Jordan,' the Gileadites seized the fords and would allow none to pass who could not pronounce 'shibboleth' with a strong aspirate. This the fugitives were unable to do. They said 'sibboleth,' as the word was pronounced by the tribes on the west, and thus they were detected (Judg. 12:1-6). Forty-two thousand were thus detected, and 'Without reprieve, adjudged to death, For want of well-pronouncing shibboleth.'
definitionAm: ወንዝ ወይም የሽንብራ እሸት። ከዮርዳኖስ በስተምስራቅ የሚኖሩ ነገዶች፣ በምዕራብ ካሉት ወንድሞቻቸው በጥልቅ ገደሎችና በፈጣን ወንዝ ተለይተው ቀስ በቀስ ለየት ያሉ ልማዶችን መከተል ጀመሩ፣ ከሞዓባውያን፣ ከእስማኤላውያንና ከአሞናውያን ጋር በመደባለቃቸው የተወሰኑ ፊደላትን ከሌሎቹ ነገዶች በሚለይ መልኩ መጥራት ጀመሩ። በዚህም ምክንያት ኤፍሬማውያን ከምዕራብ መጥተው ገለዓድን በወረሩ ጊዜ በዮፍታሔ በሚመሩት ገለዓዳውያን ተሸንፈው በዮርዳኖስ መሻገሪያዎች ለማምለጥ ሲሞክሩ፣ ገለዓዳውያን መሻገሪያዎቹን በመያዝ 'ሺቦሌት' የሚለውን ቃል አጥብቀው መጥራት የማይችሉትን ማለፍ አይፈቅዱላቸውም ነበር። ስደተኞቹ ይህንን ማድረግ አልቻሉም። በምዕራብ በኩል እንዳሉት ነገዶች 'ሲቦሌት' ይሉ ነበር፣ በዚህም ተለይተው ተያዙ (መሳ. 12፡1-6)። በዚህ መንገድ አርባ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎች ተለይተው ተያዙ፣ 'ሺቦሌትን በአግባቡ መጥራት ባለመቻላቸው ያለ ምሕረት ለሞት ተፈረደባቸው።'

definition: Fragrance, a town of Reuben, east of Jordan (Num. 32:38).
definitionAm: መዓዛ፤ ከዮርዳኖስ በስተምስራቅ የምትገኝ የሮቤል ነገድ ከተማ (ዘሁ. 32፡38)።

definition: Used in defensive warfare, varying at different times and under different circumstances in size, form, and material (1 Sam. 17:7; 2 Sam. 1:21; 1 Kings 10:17; 1 Chr. 12:8, 24, 34; Isa. 22:6; Ezek. 39:9; Nahum 2:3). Used figuratively of God and of earthly princes as the defenders of their people (Gen. 15:1; Deut. 33:29; Ps. 33:20; 84:11). Faith is compared to a shield (Eph. 6:16). Shields were usually 'anointed' (Isa. 21:5), in order to preserve them, and at the same time make the missiles of the enemy glide off them more easily.
definitionAm: በመከላከያ ጦርነት ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል፣ በተለያዩ ጊዜያትና ሁኔታዎች በመጠን፣ በቅርጽና በቁስ የሚለያይ (1 ሳሙ. 17፡7፤ 2 ሳሙ. 1፡21፤ 1 ነገሥት 10፡17፤ 1 ዜና 12፡8፣ 24፣ 34፤ ኢሳ. 22፡6፤ ሕዝ. 39፡9፤ ናሆም 2፡3)። በምሳሌያዊ ሁኔታ እግዚአብሔር እና ምድራዊ መኳንንት የሕዝባቸው ተከላካዮች እንደሆኑ ይገለጽበታል (ዘፍ. 15፡1፤ ዘዳ. 33፡29፤ መዝ. 33፡20፤ 84፡11)። እምነት ከጋሻ ጋር ይነጻጸራል (ኤፌ. 6፡16)። ጋሻዎች እንዳይበላሹ ለመጠበቅ እና በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ከጠላት የሚወረወሩ መሳሪያዎች በቀላሉ እንዲንሸራተቱ ብዙውን ጊዜ 'ይቀቡ' ነበር (ኢሳ. 21፡5)።

definition: From the verb shagah, 'to reel about through drink,' occurs in the title of Ps. 7. The plural form, shigionoth, is found in Hab. 3:1. The word denotes a lyrical poem composed under strong mental emotion; a song of impassioned imagination accompanied with suitable music; a dithyrambic ode.
definitionAm: ሻጋህ ከሚለው ግሥ የተገኘ ሲሆን ትርጉሙም 'በመጠጥ መንገዳገድ' ማለት ነው፤ በመዝሙር 7 ርዕስ ላይ ይገኛል። የብዙ ቁጥር ቅርጹ ሺጊዮኖት በዕንባቆም 3፡1 ላይ ይገኛል። ቃሉ በጠንካራ አእምሯዊ ስሜት ውስጥ ሆኖ የተቀናበረ የግጥም ግጥምን ያመለክታል፤ ተስማሚ ሙዚቃ የታጀበ የስሜታዊ ምናብ መዝሙር ነው።

definition: Overturning, a town of Issachar (Josh. 19:19).
definitionAm: መገልበጥ፤ የይሳኮር ከተማ (ኢያሱ 19፡19)።

definition: Dark, (1 Chr. 13:5), the southwestern boundary of Canaan, the Wady el-Arish. (See [580]SIHOR; [581]NILE.)
definitionAm: ጥቁር፤ (1 ዜና 13፡5) የከነዓን ደቡብ ምዕራብ ወሰን፣ ዋዲ ኤል-አሪሽ።

definition: Black-white, a stream on the borders of Asher, probably the modern Nahr Zerka, i.e., the 'crocodile brook,' or 'blue river', which rises in the Carmel range and enters the Mediterranean a little to the north of Caesarea (Josh. 19:26). Crocodiles are still found in the Zerka. Thomson suspects 'that long ages ago some Egyptians, accustomed to worship this ugly creature, settled here (viz., at Caesarea), and brought their gods with them. Once here they would not easily be exterminated' (The Land and the Book).
